Candidates can log in to their profile on the CGSSB website to view their result.

How the Final Answer Key Was Prepared

According to the notice, CGSSB first displayed the model answer key of the exam on its website. Claims and objections received from candidates were then reviewed by subject experts, and the final answer key was prepared on that basis. The final answer key and the result were announced together on 27 October 2026.

How to Check CGSSB FWLN26 Result

The notice states that the result of all candidates is available on the CGSSB websites and can be seen by logging in to your own profile.

  1. Open the official CGSSB website (links are in the Important Links section below).
  2. Log in to your candidate profile.
  3. View your FWLN26 exam result from your profile.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Check the result only through the official CGSSB websites listed in the notice.
  • Use your own registered profile to view your result.
  • Keep the notice number and exam code (FWLN26) handy for reference.

The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Result Preamble and Cut-Off Marks for Lecturer (Ayurved Dept.) - 2025 on 26 October 2026. Separate notices have been published for a Main List and a Reserve List in six subjects: Kayachikitsa, Swasthvritta, Shalakya Tantra, Panchkarma, Kaumarbhritya and Samhita (Maulik Siddhant). What Is a Result Preamble, Main List and Reserve List?

A result preamble is the notice RPSC publishes along with the result. It explains the result in brief and carries the cut-off marks for the subject.

  • Main List: the list of candidates provisionally shortlisted on the basis of the cut-off marks.
  • Reserve List: a separate list of candidates kept in reserve, who can be considered if positions remain unfilled from the main list.

How to Check RPSC Lecturer Ayurved Result 2026

Follow these steps to check the result for your subject.

  1. Visit the official RPSC website, rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
  2. Open the News or Results section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the notice titled Result Preamble and Cut-Off Marks for Lecturer (Ayurved Dept.) - 2025 with your subject name.
  4. Choose the correct list: Main List or Reserve List.
  5. Open the PDF and search for your roll number using Ctrl + F.
  6. Read the preamble and note the cut-off marks for your category.
  7. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Documents to Keep Ready for the Next Stage

No official post-result document checklist has been released yet. The list below is indicative and shortlisted candidates should follow the official notice when it arrives.

  • RPSC admit card and application form print
  • Valid photo ID proof
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Category or reservation certificate, if applicable
  • Date of birth proof
  • Recent passport size photographs

According to the notice dated 24 October 2026, the Board has completed the selection process mentioned in the advertisement dated 18-11-2025 for the 41,424 vacant Home Guard posts across all districts of Uttar Pradesh. The final selection result was announced on 03-10-2026 on the Board's website.

What Is the Last Date to Check UP Home Guard Final Marks?

The last date is 23 November 2026. After that, the facility ends automatically. The notice adds that in special circumstances, a candidate's final marks may be shared by email if the candidate applies for them. The notice does not describe how to apply in that case.

How to Check UP Home Guard Score Card 2026

Follow these steps as described in the official notice:

  1. Open the final marks link available on the UPPBPB website (https://uppbpb.gov.in) or use the link given in the Important Links section below.

The principal purpose of the updated lists is to make the category information clearer.

Candidates must continue to follow the original PET/PST shortlisting requirements and subsequent examination instructions.

SSC GD PET/PST Date 2026

Candidates provisionally shortlisted through the SSC GD Computer-Based Examination will proceed to the Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test.

The 23 October revised-result notice does not specify the PET/PST date, test centre or reporting schedule.

Candidates should check the relevant official recruitment announcements for the physical examination schedule and admit-card instructions.

SSC GD Selection Process 2026

The SSC GD Constable recruitment process includes the following stages:

  1. Computer-Based Examination: Candidates are assessed through the prescribed online examination.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test: Provisionally shortlisted candidates must meet the applicable physical efficiency requirements.
  3. Physical Standard Test: Candidates undergo the prescribed physical measurement checks.
  4. Detailed Medical Examination: Eligible candidates undergo medical evaluation under the applicable recruitment rules.
  5. Document Verification and Final Selection: Candidates must fulfil the remaining recruitment and eligibility conditions.

Appearing in the revised CBE shortlist does not guarantee final selection or appointment.

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

Direct Link to Check PNB LBO Score Card 2026

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

  • Final Result / Provisional Selection intimation
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: UPSSSC VDO Supplementary Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks.   • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Submission of Required Certificates

  • Induction/Training Process

What Is the KPSC DE Hall Ticket?

The KPSC DE hall ticket is the admission ticket issued to candidates for the Kannada language part of the Departmental Examination. KPSC conducts departmental examinations for government servants twice a year. The first session falls between January and June, and the second between July and December.

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.

  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.

  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.

  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.
  4. Contact the IBPS helpdesk through the official support email or helpline number given on the portal.
  5. Keep your online application form and registration acknowledgement ready for faster resolution.
  6. Download the corrected admit card once the issue has been updated by IBPS.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. Exact sectional timings, marks distribution, and negative-marking ratio are not available in the source material used for this article and should be checked on the admit card and the official notification.

BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has announced 660 Artisan Grade-IV vacancies under Advertisement No. 01/2026. Recruitment is being conducted for Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic and Foundryman trades across nine manufacturing units. Candidates with Class 10, a National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) and a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the respective trade can apply online from 21 October to 18 November 2026. Selected candidates will initially receive Rs. 24,000 per month during the one-year temporary period.

BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027 Overview

Recruiting Organization Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)
Advertisement Number 01/2026
Recruitment Name BHEL Artisan Recruitment 2027
Post Name Artisan Grade-IV
Trades Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Foundryman
Total Vacancies 660
Qualification Class 10 + NTC/ITI + NAC in the respective trade
Minimum Marks 60% for General/OBC and 55% for SC/ST in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to notified conditions
Age Limit Maximum 27 Years for General/EWS as of 1 October 2026; relaxations applicable
Initial Salary Rs. 24,000 per month
Initial Employment Period 1 Year as Temporary Artisan
Regular Pay Scale Rs. 29,500 - 65,000 after successful completion of the temporary period and regularization under company rules
Selection Process Computer Based Examination, Document Verification and Qualifying Skill Test
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 21 October 2026, 10:00 AM
Application Last Date 18 November 2026, 11:45 PM
Tentative Examination Date 11 December 2026
Job Location Nine BHEL Manufacturing Units Across India
Official Website careers.bhel.in

Important Eligibility Notice: Candidates must possess both the prescribed NTC/ITI and NAC qualifications in the relevant trade. Only full-time regular courses are accepted. Applicants can select only one manufacturing unit and one trade. Selected Artisan Grade-IV employees must serve at their allocated manufacturing unit for at least 20 years, during which transfer requests will not be entertained.

Event Date and Time

Qualification and Age Cut-off Date 1 October 2026

BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade:

  1. Class 10 or Matriculation.
  2. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI).
  3. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).

The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026. Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date.

Minimum Marks Requirement

Category Minimum Marks
General and OBC 60% in both NTC/ITI and NAC
SC and ST 55% in both NTC/ITI and NAC, subject to the applicable reservation conditions

Only full-time regular courses will be considered. The National Apprenticeship Certificate must be issued by the competent authority.

Special Condition: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against vacancies not reserved for their respective categories will be considered under general merit standards, without relaxation in the minimum educational percentage. Eligible Ex-servicemen claiming prescribed trade equivalency may receive the notified exemption from minimum marks requirements.

Desirable Language Knowledge

Knowledge of the regional language is desirable for manufacturing units in Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hindi knowledge is desirable for the other manufacturing units.

Maximum Age Ceiling: The age of a candidate, including all permissible relaxations, must not exceed 56 years as of 1 October 2026.

Applicants claiming work-experience-based relaxation must submit the relevant experience certificate in the format prescribed by BHEL.

BHEL Artisan Salary 2027

Selected candidates will initially work as Temporary Artisans for one year with consolidated monthly wages of Rs. 24,000.

Employment Stage Salary / Pay Scale
Temporary Artisan - First Year Rs. 24,000 per month
Artisan Grade-IV After Regularization Rs. 29,500 - 65,000

Upon successful completion of the temporary period, candidates will be regularized in the Artisan Grade-IV establishment according to the prevailing company rules. Applicable allowances will be provided as per the rules in force at regularization.

BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027

Selection is conducted through a two-stage process consisting of a Computer Based Examination followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill Test.

  1. Stage I: Computer Based Examination (CBE).
  2. Stage II: Document Verification and Skill Test.
  3. Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test.

Candidates are generally shortlisted for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:3 against the available category-wise vacancies for the relevant unit and trade. For a single vacancy in a trade/category, up to five candidates may be shortlisted.

Computer Based Examination Minimum Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR/EWS 40%
OBC (NCL), SC and ST 30%

For eligible PwBD and Ex-servicemen candidates, the notification permits further qualifying-mark relaxation under specified conditions, subject to minimum standards of 30% for UR/EWS and 22.5% for OBC/SC/ST.

The Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is determined by CBE marks after successful completion of document verification and the Skill Test.

BHEL Artisan Exam Pattern 2027

The BHEL Artisan Computer Based Examination will contain 120 multiple-choice questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes.

Subject Questions Marks
Trade-Related Questions 70 70
Engineering / Calculations 30 30
Reasoning 20 20
Total 120 120
  • Examination Mode: Computer Based Examination
  • Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice
  • Total Questions: 120
  • Total Marks: 120
  • Examination Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Correct Answer: 1 Mark
  • Incorrect Answer: Deduction of 0.25 Mark
  • Languages: Hindi, English and one selected regional language option

The examination will be trilingual. Candidates may choose Hindi, English or a notified regional language such as Kannada, Telugu or Tamil. Where the English and Hindi versions differ, the English version will be treated as authentic.

BHEL Artisan Syllabus 2027

According to the official examination pattern, candidates will be tested in three areas:

Section Coverage
Trade Knowledge Technical knowledge associated with the candidate's selected trade
Engineering / Calculations Engineering-related calculations and knowledge assessed in the examination
Reasoning Reasoning ability

The supplied examination pattern document specifies the number of questions for each section but does not provide a detailed chapter-wise syllabus. Candidates should follow any subsequent trade-specific syllabus or examination instructions published by BHEL.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have issued recruitment information for 1,215 Station Master vacancies under CEN 08/2026. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university can apply, subject to the prescribed age limit of 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027 and A-2 medical fitness requirements. The initial basic pay is Rs. 35,400 under Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Online applications are scheduled to begin on 27 October 2026 and close on 25 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through rrbapply.gov.in.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)

Application Portal rrbapply.gov.in

Important: Candidates must meet the A-2 medical standard, including the prescribed vision requirements without glasses. The supplied CEN states that candidates who have undergone LASIK or other surgery to correct refractive error are not eligible for Station Master.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

CBAT Examination Date WILL ANNOUNCE

Applicants must submit the online form by 25 November 2026. Candidates who have submitted their applications can complete the prescribed fee payment by 27 November 2026. The correction facility opens after the application window closes.

RRB Station Master Vacancy 2026

The main recruitment summary of CEN 08/2026 specifies 1,215 Station Master vacancies in Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix. Vacancies are intended for different Railway Recruitment Boards and Zonal Railways.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Station Master 1,215
Total 1,215

Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS and eligible Ex-Servicemen will apply under the prescribed rules. Candidates should check the officially confirmed RRB-wise and Railway Zone-wise vacancy distribution before choosing their RRB and preferences.

RRBs may increase or decrease the number of vacancies according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The supplied CEN 08/2026 document provides recruitment information for Station Master posts under the Ministry of Railways. Its main vacancy summary lists 1,215 posts with initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400, an age limit of 20 to 33 years and A-2 medical requirements.

The detailed document also includes examination fees, selection conditions, CBT and CBAT patterns, application instructions and certificate formats. Candidates should obtain the authenticated notification and any corrections from the official RRB website before applying.

Official Recruitment Notices: View Station Master CEN 08/2026 Notices on RRB Website

RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university by 25 November 2026 and satisfy the applicable age, nationality and medical requirements.

Eligibility Criteria Requirement
Post Name Station Master
Educational Qualification Degree from a Recognized University or Equivalent
Qualification Cut-Off Date 25 November 2026
Medical Fitness A-2

Important: Candidates awaiting the final results of the prescribed educational qualification are not eligible to apply. The required degree or equivalent qualification must have been obtained by the application closing date.

Nationality Requirements

Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to other nationality categories specifically permitted in the notification, subject to the prescribed eligibility-certificate requirements where applicable.

RRB Station Master Age Limit 2026

The prescribed age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027, with relaxation for eligible categories.

Station Master candidates must satisfy the A-2 medical standard, including strict unaided vision requirements.

Candidates shortlisted for CBAT must produce the prescribed original medical vision certificate as per Annexure-VI or Annexure-VIA, whichever applies. Candidates without the required certificate will not be permitted to appear in CBAT.

Failure to meet the A-2 medical requirements may result in rejection, and no alternative appointment will be offered for medical unsuitability.

Station Master posts carry initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

The notified Rs. 35,400 amount is the initial basic pay, not the final in-hand salary. Gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

RRB Station Master Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 500 for general fee categories and Rs. 250 for eligible concession categories. Candidates who appear in the CBT may receive the applicable refund after deduction of bank charges.

Application Fee Refund Conditions

  • Candidates must appear in the CBT to qualify for the applicable fee refund.
  • The refund will be credited to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account confirmed during the application process.
  • Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their linked bank account is valid and operational.
  • No refund is admissible for rejected or incomplete applications under the stated conditions.
  • Economically Backward Class (EBC) fee concession is different from EWS and OBC reservation.
  • Candidates claiming EBC fee concession must possess the required valid income or supporting certificate by the application closing date.

Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI through the prescribed online payment facility.

RRB Station Master Selection Process 2026

The selection process includes a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification and Medical Examination.

  1. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear in the objective examination, and normalized CBT scores are used for CBAT shortlisting.
  2. Computer Based Aptitude Test: Candidates shortlisted from the CBT must qualify in each prescribed CBAT test battery.
  3. Document Verification: Candidates are called according to combined CBT and CBAT merit, Railway preferences and vacancies.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed A-2 medical fitness standard.

Selection Shortlisting and Merit Weightage

Particulars Selection Rule
CBAT Shortlisting Normally 8 Times the RRB-Wise Vacancies
Document Verification Shortlisting Normally 1:1 of RRB-Wise Vacancies
CBT Weightage 70%
CBAT Weightage 30%
Final Selection Combined Merit, CBAT Qualification, Documents and Medical Fitness

CBAT shortlisting numbers may increase or decrease according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

RRB Station Master Exam Pattern 2026

The CBT comprises 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. There is a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Mental Reasoning 20 20
Total 100 100

The minimum qualifying marks establish examination eligibility but do not guarantee shortlisting for CBAT.

RRB Station Master Syllabus 2026

The CBT syllabus includes Basic Science, Mathematics, Data Analysis and Interpretation, Logical Capability and Mental Reasoning.

Basic Science, Mathematical and Analytical Capability - 60 Marks

  • Number System, Ratio and Proportion, Averages and Percentages.
  • Profit, Loss, Discount, Time, Speed, Distance, Power and Work.
  • Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM and HCF.
  • Geometry, Trigonometry, Area and Volume.
  • Basic Probability and Statistics.
  • Units, Measurements, Mass, Weight, Density, Energy, Friction, Heat and Temperature.
  • Basic Electricity, Levers and Simple Machines.
  • Data Interpretation through Tables, Charts, Graphs, Pie Charts and Scatter Plots.
  • Venn Diagrams, Data Sufficiency and Data Arrangement.

Logical Capability - 20 Marks

  • Binary Logic and Syllogism.
  • Clocks and Calendars.
  • Assumptions and Blood Relations.
  • Family Trees and Logic-Based Puzzles.
  • English Reading Comprehension.

Mental Reasoning - 20 Marks

  • Analogy.
  • Series Completion.
  • Coding and Decoding.
  • Ranking and Arrangement Problems.

The topics listed in the notification are illustrative and may not represent an exhaustive question list.

RRB Station Master CBAT 2026

The Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) is mandatory for candidates shortlisted through CBT. Candidates must secure a minimum T-score of 42 in each CBAT test battery, without category-wise relaxation.

CBAT Particulars Details
Shortlisting Normally 8 Times RRB-Wise Vacancies
Minimum T-Score 42 in Each Test Battery
Language English and Hindi
Negative Marking No
Vision Certificate Mandatory in Prescribed Original Format
Final Merit Weightage CBT 70% + CBAT 30%

Candidates must qualify in every test battery to be considered for the final merit list. There is no relaxation in the minimum T-score for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS or Ex-Servicemen candidates.

The online application process is scheduled to begin on 27 October 2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Boards application portal.

Apply Online: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal

How to Apply Online for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the unified Railway Recruitment Boards website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Open the Station Master Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN 08/2026.

Candidates cannot modify the email ID, mobile number or other details entered during account creation. No application correction requests will be entertained after the correction window closes.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Salary

The CWC salary for the Assistant Manager posts is Rs. 40000-140000 in the E-1 scale, and for the Junior Executive posts it is Rs. 29000-93000 in the S-V scale (IDA pattern). Besides basic pay and IDA, candidates are entitled to other allowances, perks and benefits as per the policies of the Corporation. The notification also lists CPF, contributory pension, gratuity, LTC, performance related pay or variable pay, and medical reimbursement as admissible for regular employees.

Post Name Scale of Pay (IDA)
Assistant Manager (all six posts, codes 01 to 06) Rs. 40000-140000 (E-1)
Junior Executive (General and Technical, codes 07 and 08) Rs. 29000-93000 (S-V)

Selected candidates are appointed on probation. Assistant Manager candidates have to furnish a bond of Rs. 1,00,000 and Junior Executive candidates a bond of Rs. 50,000, to serve the Corporation for a minimum of two years, at the time of joining.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee Intimation Charges Total
SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Serviceman and women candidates Nil Rs. 500 Rs. 500/-
Other candidates (UR/EWS/OBC) Rs. 850 Rs. 500 Rs. 1,350/-
  • The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted.
  • Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets.
  • A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post.
  • On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The CWC selection process depends on the post. Candidates must first register for the online recruitment process for each post.

Post Code Selection Process
01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 06 (Assistant Manager posts) Online Test + Document Verification followed by Interview
07 and 08 (Junior Executive posts) Online Test + Document Verification
  • Candidates are shortlisted from the online test in the ratio of 1:5 for the Assistant Manager posts (Interview) and 1:3 for the Junior Executive posts (Document Verification). The Interview and Document Verification are conducted at Delhi.
  • For the Assistant Manager posts, the Interview carries 30 marks. The minimum qualifying marks in the Interview are 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The weightage of the online exam and the Interview is 85:15.
  • For the Junior Executive posts, appointment is based on the marks obtained in the online test, after successful Document Verification.
  • Each candidate must obtain a minimum score in each section and a minimum total score. The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge test (posts 02 to 06 and 08) and for the Language & Comprehension Abilities Descriptive Test (all posts) are 40% for Unreserved and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • If two or more candidates get the same score, the senior candidate by date of birth is placed higher. A wait list up to 100% of the vacancies in each category may be kept.
  • Cut-offs are applied in two stages, on the scores in individual tests and on the total score. If the exam is held in more than one session, the scores are equated and normalized.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The online examination is of 3 hours in total, with each test separately timed. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks of the question for each wrong answer, and there is no penalty for an unanswered question. Each post has 202 questions and 230 maximum marks.

CWC reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination. Other details will be given in an Information Handout, available with the call letters on www.cewacor.nic.in. The tentative list of exam centres across states and union territories is given in Annexure I of the notification, and the choice of centre once made is final.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Syllabus

The notification says the syllabus is broad and indicative and may change slightly in the examination. The professional/subject knowledge topics are as follows.

  • Assistant Manager (Technical) (02): Agricultural Process Engineering and Storage Systems; Food Engineering and Preservation; Food Chemistry and Nutrition; Food Microbiology and Pest Control; General Biology and Biotechnology; Grain Storage, Quality Control and Chemical Preservation.
  • Assistant Manager (Finance) (03): Financial Accounting (Ind AS, GAAP, bank reconciliation, cash flow statement, final accounts, payroll accounting, cost accounting); Taxation (Income Tax Act, 2025 and Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017); Auditing (company audit, audit reports and certificates, ledger scrutiny, internal control).
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Civil (04): Structural Engineering; Geotechnical Engineering and Geomatics Engineering; Water Resources Engineering; Environmental Engineering; Transportation Engineering; Surveying; Project Management and Planning; Concrete Technology and Prestressed Concrete.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Electrical (05): Electric Circuits; Electromagnetic Fields; Signals and Systems; Electrical Machines; Power Systems; Control Systems; Electrical and Electronic Measurements; Analog and Digital Electronics; Power Electronics.
  • Assistant Manager (Engineering)-Mechanical (06): Applied Mechanics and Machine Design; Thermal Engineering and Fluid Mechanics; Manufacturing Technology and Engineering Materials; Production Engineering; Industrial Engineering.
  • Junior Executive (Technical) (08): Basic Agriculture; Botany; Zoology; Chemistry; Physics.

The detailed sub-topics for each of these are given in the notification PDF.

Documents Required for CWC Recruitment 2026

The following documents, in original along with a self-attested photocopy, are required at the time of Interview/Document Verification, as applicable.

  • Valid Interview/Document Verification call letter with a 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm photograph pasted
  • System generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of date of birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X certificate with date of birth)
  • Photo identity proof (see the identity verification section of the notification)
  • Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications from Std. X onwards
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format for SC/ST/OBC candidates. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate based on the income for FY 2025-26, 2024-25 and 2023-24, issued on or after 01.04.2026 and not later than 15.11.2026.
  • EWS candidates: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format for FY 2025-26, valid for 2026-27 and in possession on or before 15.11.2026
  • PwBD candidates: Disability certificate in the prescribed format issued by the District Medical Board, and the scribe details if a scribe was used
  • Ex-Servicemen: Copy of the discharge certificate/pension payment order and documentary proof of rank. Those still in defence service must submit a certificate that they will be relieved on or before 15.11.2027.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices/PSUs: No Objection Certificate from the employer
  • 1984 riot affected persons: Certificate from the District Magistrate. Candidates in the non-Indian-citizen categories: certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

Candidates should not send documents directly to CWC before or after Document Verification. Outstation candidates called for Document Verification/Interview are reimbursed A.C. III tier rail fare/bus fare or actual expenses, whichever is less, on production of proof of travel.

How to Apply for CWC Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. A candidate can apply for one or more posts according to the qualification and eligibility, but must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. Not more than one application should be submitted for a particular post.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

  1. Keep ready a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration, a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and the details for online payment.
  2. Go to www.cewacor.nic.in, click the link "Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026" and then "Click here to apply online for Advertisement No. 2026/01".
  3. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and e-mail ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password are generated and also sent by e-mail and SMS.
  4. Fill in the application form. The "Save and Next" option can be used to save the data and verify it. The name of the candidate and the father/husband must be spelt as in the Class 10 certificate/mark sheet.
  5. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
  6. Preview the form, click "Complete Registration" after verifying, then use the "Payment" tab to pay the fee and click "Submit".
  7. Take a printout of the application form and the e-receipt. Do not send them to CWC.

Documents to Upload

Document Specification
Photograph Recent passport style colour photograph, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm, file size 20 KB to 50 KB (200 x 230 pixels preferred)
Signature On white paper with black ink (not in capital letters), file size 10 KB to 20 KB (140 x 60 pixels preferred)
Left Thumb Impression On white paper with black or blue ink, JPG/JPEG, 3 cm x 3 cm (240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 20 KB to 50 KB
Hand-written Declaration In English, in the candidate's own handwriting (not in capital letters), JPG/JPEG, 10 cm x 5 cm (800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI), file size 50 KB to 100 KB

The text of the declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Visually impaired candidates or others who cannot write may get the text typed and put their left thumb impression below it. The online application is not registered unless the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration are uploaded as specified.

CWC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • All details in the online application, including name, category, date of birth, post, address, mobile number, e-mail ID and exam centre, are final, and no change is allowed after submission.
  • Online applications cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is neither refunded nor held in reserve for any other examination. For multiple applications for the same post, only the latest valid application is retained and the fee for the others is forfeited.
  • Candidature at every stage is provisional. CWC can cancel the candidature at any stage if the candidate does not meet the eligibility norms or has given false information.
  • Candidates must carry the call letter, the original photo identity proof and its photocopy to the exam. The name on the call letter must match the photo identity proof. Ration cards and learner's driving licences are not accepted as ID proof.
  • Biometric data (left thumb impression) and a photograph are captured on the day of the exam and verified at Document Verification/Interview.
  • Candidates reporting late are not permitted to take the exam. Candidates may need to be at the venue for up to 4 hours or more.
  • Items not allowed in the exam centre include mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, calculators, watches, handbags, belts, caps, metallic items and eatables. Only half-sleeved clothing and open-toe footwear are allowed.
  • Use of unfair means can lead to disqualification, debarment and an FIR. CWC analyses the answers of candidates to detect similarity patterns.
  • Candidates with disabilities using a scribe get compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour or as advised. The scribe must be one step lower in qualification and must not be a candidate for any post in this advertisement.
  • Intimations are sent by e-mail and SMS only. All announcements and any corrigendum are published only on www.cewacor.nic.in. In case of a dispute over interpretation, the English version prevails.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness. No person dismissed or compulsorily retired from CWC, a State or Central Government department or a PSU, or convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude, is eligible.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

IRCON International Limited, a Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Railways, will hold walk-in interviews for Manager/Electrical posts on contract. The interviews are on 19 and 20 November 2026 at its Eastern Region office, 378, Prantik Pally, Kasba, Near 47B, Bus Stand Kolkata-700107, and on 23 November 2026 at H. No.- 06, 2nd Floor, Opposite Koyel Hotel, Vivekanand Path, Ulubari, Guwahati, Assam – 781007. At both venues registration opens at 09:30 am and the interviews start at 10:00 AM. There are 37 posts (Advt. No. C-12/2026) for IRCON's Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions, at a fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

IRCON Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue

Particulars Details
Organisation IRCON International Limited
Advertisement No. C-12/2026 (dated 23.10.2026)

Venue (Guwahati) IRCON INTERNATIONAL LIMITED, H. No.- 06, 2nd Floor, Opposite Koyel Hotel, Vivekanand Path, Ulubari, Guwahati, Assam – 781007

Pay Fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month

Who Can Attend Holders of a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (60% or more) with at least five years of experience, aged 50 years or less on 01.10.2026
Official Website www.ircon.org

The official notification does not specify an application fee.

About IRCON

IRCON International Limited calls itself a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways. It builds turnkey infrastructure projects in Railways, Highways, Buildings, the Power sector and other areas, in India and abroad. Its registered office is at C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017. These posts are for its Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions.

Posts and Eligibility

The only post is Manager/Electrical – on contract. It has 37 vacancies, and the notice divides them by category as shown below. The notice says the number of posts may change after a further assessment of requirement.

Category Posts
UR 13
OBC 11
SC 07
EWS 03
ST 03
Total 37

Educational Qualification

Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade from recognized University/ Institute approved by AICTE/UGC, as on 01.10.2026.

The percentage is taken from the consolidated mark sheet issued by the University/Institution. If the university or institute does not issue a consolidated mark sheet, the final percentage is the average of all semesters/years. Candidates must write their percentage without rounding it off. If the mark sheets show CGPA/OGPA/DGPA:

  • If the university/institute has no rule for converting CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or a letter grade into a percentage, a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%. A score on any other scale is prorated.
  • If the university/institute does provide a conversion, the candidate gives the equivalent percentage using that institution's norms. A certificate to this effect may be obtained from the university/institute, and it must be produced at the time of verification.

Experience

Candidates need at least five years of experience after their qualification, as on 01.10.2026. The experience must be in Electrical construction, Procurement, Installation, Testing and commissioning/TRD Maintenance in Railways, Metro Rail or Power Transmission/Distribution utilities. Experience in Railway OHE/Power Supply/SCADA, E&M or Electrical utility Diversion will be preferred. Teaching, training, consultancy or freelancing experience does not count as relevant experience.

Age Limit

The maximum age is 50 years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations follow the Government of India's guidelines, as long as the candidate has the required qualification and experience.

Medical Standards

Candidates should be in sound health and free from colour blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed.

Candidates can apply whether or not they are working on the cut-off date, as long as they have the essential qualification and post-qualification experience. Ex-contract employees of IRCON whose services ended because their projects closed can also apply if they meet these requirements. They must send a copy of their termination letter with the application, and the new appointment will be a fresh appointment with no link to their earlier employment in IRCON. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

Pay and Contract Terms

  • Pay: a fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month, plus an annual increment of 5% on the fixed consolidated pay after each completed year of service. There are no allowances on top of the fixed pay.
  • Contract period: initially 18 months, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract may be extended for another year if the candidate's services are satisfactory and the Project requires it.
  • The posts are only for the NFR Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions and not for IRCON's regular establishment. The appointment is co-terminus with the Project and gives no right to claim absorption into the regular establishment or appointment in other projects of the company.
  • Medical cover: contract employees must take a Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for themselves, covering Covid-19 and other diseases, with a premium ceiling of Rs 4000/- per annum. The premium is reimbursed when the employee submits a copy of the policy and the original premium receipt.
  • PF: the minimum PF prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 is deducted from the salary, and IRCON makes a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends.
  • Leave: one leave for each calendar month of service. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated, but unused leave is not encashed during the contract or on resignation or termination. No other type of leave is admissible.
  • Employees get one weekly off and the public holidays on which the project office is closed. Working hours, working days and offs are the same as for the Project.
  • TA/DA is admissible if the employee is deputed on outstation duty. No other perks or benefits are admissible.

What to Bring

Candidates must bring the originals and one set of photocopies of the following:

  • The application, typed on A-4 size paper in the format attached to the notice. The format asks for personal and contact details, community, whether any relative works or has worked in IRCON, last/present organisation, academic and professional qualifications with marks, and work experience as on 01-10-2026. It also needs a self-attested passport-size photograph and the signed declaration.
  • Experience certificates in chronological order. Candidates in a current job must also bring the last two months' salary slips from their present employer, because an offer letter alone is not accepted as proof of experience.
  • Date of birth/Class X passing certificate as proof of date of birth.
  • Caste certificate/EWS certificate/age relaxation certificate, in the format prescribed by the Government of India's guidelines.
  • Qualification degree/diploma and the mark sheets of all semesters/years, so that the percentage in the qualifying degree can be calculated.
  • For ex-contract employees of IRCON: a copy of the termination letter.

OBC candidates need a caste certificate issued by the competent authority for appointment to services under the Government of India, in the Annexure-A format attached to the notice. Only an OBC certificate issued in the current financial year will be accepted as proof of not belonging to the "creamy layer".

What Happens on the Day

  1. Registration opens at 09:30 am at the venue for that date. Candidates can register up to 1:00 pm only.
  2. Interviews start at 10:00 AM.
  3. Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be interviewed. Candidates must bring the original certificates proving their age, community, educational qualifications and experience. Without them, the interview will not be held.
  4. Depending on how many candidates register, the process may take more than one day, so candidates should plan their travel with this in mind.

Requests to change the date, time or location will not be entertained.

Important Instructions

  • If any information a candidate gives is false, incorrect or does not match the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The company reserves the right to increase, decrease, cancel, restrict or modify the requirement at any time without giving a reason.
  • Any communication, corrigendum or notification about this advertisement will be uploaded only on IRCON's website, www.ircon.org.
  • For doubts, queries or clarifications, email [email protected].

Conditions for Both Posts

  • UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS candidates need a First class in B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc Engineering from AICTE approved Colleges in the above disciplines.
  • Candidates with a first class in AMIE / AMIETE / GIETE in the above disciplines are also eligible to apply.
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates with a Pass class in the above degree / disciplines are eligible to apply.
  • Other equivalent disciplines and dual specialisations will NOT be considered.
  • Where the final marks are awarded as a letter grade (CGPA/GPI/SGPA etc.), the equivalent percentage is worked out with the conversion formula of the candidate's Institute/University. Shortlisted candidates must submit the conversion certificate/formula at the time of interview. Failure to submit it will result in disqualification.
  • Candidates whose degree certificate shows a specialisation that does not tally with the branch entered in the application will not be considered for interview.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility for each post in the official notification.

BEL Age Limit 2026

For both Probationary Engineer posts, the maximum age limit for Unreserved/EWS candidates is 25 years as on the crucial date of 1 October 2026.

Age Relaxation

Category Relaxation
OBC (NCL) 3 years
SC / ST 5 years
PwBD 10 years
PwBD & OBC (NCL) 13 years
PwBD & SC/ST 15 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years (as per Govt. guidelines)

For PwBD candidates who belong to the SC/ST/OBC (NCL) category, the PwBD relaxation is in addition to the category relaxation. Proof of age is accepted only as the certificate issued by a Board of Secondary Education for passing Matriculation/Higher Secondary, showing the date of birth. If that certificate does not show the date of birth, a Birth certificate issued by the competent authority will be considered.

BEL Salary 2026

Post Pay Level Pay Scale
Probationary Engineer (Electronics) and Probationary Engineer (Mechanical) E-II Grade Basic Pay Rs. 40,000-3%-1,40,000; CTC: 13 lacs (Approx.)

The basic pay scale is due for revision with effect from 1 January 2027. On top of basic pay, selected candidates will be entitled to DA, HRA, Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement and other perquisites as admissible.

Training, Service Agreement and Posting

  • Selected candidates will undergo an Orientation / On-the-Job training for a period of 6 months.
  • They will have to sign a Service Agreement to serve the Company for 2 years and must be willing to serve in any of the Units / Offices of BEL. The amount payable for breach of the Service Contract is Rs. 2,00,000/-.
  • The openings are for the Production/Support Services departments of BEL Units/Offices at Bangalore (Karnataka), Ghaziabad (UP), Pune/Nagpur/Navi Mumbai (Maharashtra), Hyderabad/Ibrahimpatnam (Telangana), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Palasamudram/Nimmaluru/Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Panchkula (Haryana) and Kotdwara (Uttarakhand).
  • Depending on the Company's requirements, selected candidates may be posted to any place in India or any Section/Department/Division/Unit of BEL, at the discretion of the Management, without detriment to the emoluments.

BEL Application Fee 2026

Category Fee
GEN / EWS / OBC (NCL) Rs 1000/- + GST, i.e. Rs. 1180/-
SC / ST / PwBD / ESM Exempted

The fee is paid online through the SBI e-Pay Lite payment gateway by Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, Wallets or UPI, by 18 November 2026 (11:59 PM). Fee paid once will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be held for any other recruitment or selection process. If the fee is not received from a UR, EWS or OBC (NCL) candidate, the application will be rejected. BEL does not charge any fee or ask for money deposits at any stage of the recruitment other than this application fee.

BEL Selection Process 2026

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT), with a weightage of 85 marks
  2. Interview, with a weightage of 15 marks

Computer Based Test

Candidates who meet the qualifying criteria and whose online applications are accepted are provisionally shortlisted for the CBT. They must log on to the BEL website with their credentials to download and print the CBT call letter, and follow the instructions in it. Call letters will not be sent by e-mail or by post. Candidates will not be reimbursed the cost of travel to the CBT.

Shortlisting for Interview

Candidates are provisionally shortlisted for interview on the basis of their CBT performance, in the ratio of 1:5, discipline-wise and category-wise. The list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the BEL website through query mode.

Interview and Final Selection

The final selection is based on performance in both the CBT and the interview. Minimum qualifying marks apply to the CBT and the interview separately: 35% for General/OBC/EWS candidates and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Outstation candidates shortlisted for the interview are eligible for reimbursement of the to-and-fro AC Chair Car or III Tier AC train fare by the shortest route from their correspondence address to the place of interview. The results of candidates selected in the interview will be published on the BEL website. Candidates can choose to answer the CBT and the interview in English or Hindi. Eligibility has to be proved with original documents at the time of document verification, and appointment depends on being found medically fit by the Company's Medical Authorities.

BEL Exam Pattern 2026

Part Subject Questions Marks Duration
1 Technical 100 100 120 minutes (total)
2 General Aptitude and Reasoning 25 25
  Total 125 125
  • Each question carries 1 mark.
  • 1/4th of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer. No marks are given for unattempted or marked-for-review questions.
  • The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi only). If the Hindi version has an error or variation, the English version will be treated as valid.
  • The minimum qualifying marks are 35% for General/OBC/EWS candidates and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

CBT Centres (Annexure-A)

The list is tentative and not exhaustive. BEL reserves the right to change the centre, city or state based on the number of candidates and the availability of centres.

BEL Syllabus 2026

  • Technical section: objective type questions from the core engineering subjects that candidates have studied in their own engineering discipline or specialisation.
  • General Aptitude section: questions that test analytical and reasoning abilities.

The notice says candidates should prepare based on the curriculum of their engineering qualification. It does not print a topic-wise syllabus.

How to Apply Online for BEL Recruitment 2026

  1. Keep these ready: a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number (both must stay valid for the whole recruitment process), a scanned passport-size colour photograph, a scanned signature in JPG/JPEG format and the other documents required by the advertisement.
  2. Click the "Click here" link in front of "To Register" to start the online registration for BEL.
  3. Step-I (Registration): fill in the Personal Details and Contact Details, press "Generate OTP", and enter the two OTPs sent to your mobile number and e-mail ID.
  4. Tick the "I Agree" box after the Declaration, click "Re-verify", check the details and press "Submit". Your Application Sequence No. (User ID) and Password will be sent to your e-mail ID and mobile number.
  5. Step-II (Application): click "Go To Application", or log in again with your User ID and Password. Then fill in the Personal Details, Additional Details, Communication Details, Qualification Details and Declaration, and choose 5 CBT centres.
  6. Upload the relevant documents, including your photograph and signature. Click "Preview", correct any error and then click "Submit". Details cannot be edited after submission.
  7. On the SBI e-Pay Lite payment gateway, check the details and pay the fee if your category has to pay. You will then return to your application form. Keep the Payment Acknowledgement Slip.
  8. Press "PRINT" and save or print the application form as a PDF. The print option will not be available after the last date of online submission.

Photograph and Signature Specifications

  • Photograph: recent passport-size colour photo with a white background, not more than 3 months old; .jpg or .jpeg format; 100 KB to 200 KB; scanner at 200 dpi; 3.5 cm (width) x 4.5 cm (height). Photos with a cap, hat or dark glasses are not accepted. Religious headwear is allowed but must not cover the face. Use the same photograph throughout the recruitment process.
  • Signature: sign on white paper with a black ink pen. Only the applicant may sign. Scan only the signature area, not the whole page, in .jpg or .jpeg format, 80 KB to 150 KB.

Documents Required

  • Age proof: a Matriculation/Higher Secondary certificate showing the date of birth, or a Birth certificate from the competent authority if that certificate does not show the date of birth.
  • EWS: an EWS Certificate / Income and Asset Certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026 and issued on or after 01.04.2026. The applicant's photo on it must be pasted, signed and stamped by the issuing authority.
  • OBC (NCL): a caste certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 01.10.2025, in the latest prescribed format for posts under the Government of India/Central PSUs. It must show the date of issue and the caste name spelt exactly as in the Central List. Candidates in the "Creamy Layer" must apply as Unreserved candidates.
  • SC/ST: a caste certificate in the latest format prescribed by the Government of India, showing the date of issue and the caste name. The caste or tribe must appear in the Central List of SC/ST of the respective state.
  • PwBD: a PwBD certificate in the latest format for the relevant category of disability, showing a disability of at least 40%. Conditions "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Annexure-3 in the prescribed format, signed by the competent authority.
  • At the interview (if shortlisted): the CGPA/GPI/SGPA to percentage conversion certificate/formula, where it applies, and a NOC from the current employer for candidates working in Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies.
  • At document verification: the relevant valid documents in original.

BEL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Do not send a hard copy of the application form or any documents to BEL, by post or in person.
  • The category entered in the online form cannot be changed later. An application cannot be withdrawn after it is submitted, and no request for changes will be accepted.
  • Submit only one application per post. If there are several, only the one with the higher Application Sequence Number will be considered, and fee paid against one number will not be adjusted against another.
  • Candidature may be cancelled at any stage, and an appointment summarily terminated, if a candidate is found ineligible or to have given incorrect information or hidden any material fact. Canvassing of any kind leads to disqualification.
  • As per the company's medical standards, candidates with colour blindness are not suitable for the post of Probationary Engineer in the Electronics and Mechanical disciplines.
  • Admission at every stage is purely provisional. An interview call letter or provisional offer does not mean BEL has cleared the candidature, and BEL may debar a candidate at any stage. Candidates who are not selected will not be informed separately.
  • Criteria, relaxations and terms for internal candidates are as per the internal advertisement dated 28.10.2026. Trainee/Project/Fixed Tenure Engineers working in BEL on a short-term basis must apply as external candidates and inform the concerned Unit/SBU HR before the interview. Dependents/Children of BEL employees must apply as external candidates only.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum or time extension will be posted in the "Careers" section of www.bel-india.in.
  • For clarifications, use the Helpdesk tab in the application portal or call the Toll-free Number 9152028159 (Help Desk +919152028159, Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM). No other form of communication will be entertained.
  • BEL warns job seekers against fraudsters who pose as its representatives and demand payment for jobs. The Company is not liable for any loss from such fraud and reserves the right to take legal action, including criminal action, against them.

The CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR-CFTRI), Mysuru, has released the CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 notification for 28 Technician (1) vacancies across 13 trades. Candidates who have passed Class 10 with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with the prescribed ITI certificate or qualifying trade experience, can apply online at recruitment.cftri.res.in. The application process started on 19 October 2026 and closes on 18 November 2026. Applicants must also send the signed hard copy of their application with the required documents by 26 November 2026. The posts carry Pay Level 2, ranging from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 Overview

CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute is a constituent laboratory of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research under the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The institute is recruiting Technician (1) personnel through direct recruitment under Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026.

The online application window for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 is open from 19 October to 18 November 2026. Candidates must complete the online application, including the required fee payment, before the closing time. CSIR CFTRI Technician Notification PDF 2026

CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute has released the detailed Technician (1) Recruitment 2026 notification under Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026. The notification provides trade-wise vacancies, eligibility conditions, reservation rules, application instructions, selection criteria and examination details.

Candidates should read the complete notification before applying. It is available through the official recruitment website at recruitment.cftri.res.in.

Download CSIR CFTRI Technician Notification PDF 2026

CSIR CFTRI Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and trade requirements as on 18 November 2026. The minimum qualification is Class 10 or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with one of the accepted trade qualifications or experience routes.

Educational Qualification

Applicants must meet the Class 10 Science and 55% marks requirement and satisfy any one of the following conditions in the relevant trade:

  • ITI certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the concerned trade.
  • Two years of full-time apprenticeship training in the concerned trade from a recognized institution.
  • Three years of work experience in the concerned trade in an eligible Central or State Government department, public sector undertaking or autonomous organization, as specified in the notification.

The required ITI certificate or experience must correspond to the trade selected in the application. Candidates should check the exact trade name and supporting-document conditions in the official notification.

Age Limit

The minimum age for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 is 18 years and the maximum age is 28 years as on 18 November 2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to eligible candidates under Government of India rules.

Additional relaxation provisions apply to eligible widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Candidates seeking relaxation must provide the prescribed supporting certificates.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Salary 2026

The Technician (1) post carries Pay Level 2 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay scale of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200. The notification mentions approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 37,260 at the minimum of the pay scale, including admissible House Rent Allowance at Mysuru headquarters.

Salary Details Amount
Pay Level Level 2

Selected employees may also receive applicable Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, medical benefits, Leave Travel Concession and other benefits under CSIR rules.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Application Fee 2026

The application fee is Rs. 500 for candidates who are not eligible for exemption. SC, ST, PwBD, women and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee, subject to the required documentary proof. The fee must be paid through SBI Collect and the payment receipt uploaded to the application portal.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Technician (1) posts consists of application screening, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive written examination. Candidates shortlisted after screening will be invited for the relevant Trade Test. Only those who qualify in the Trade Test will proceed to the written examination.

The written examination consists of three papers. Paper I is qualifying in nature, while marks obtained in Papers II and III determine the final merit list, subject to the prescribed conditions.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Exam Pattern 2026

Paper Subject Questions Marks
Paper I Mental Ability Test 50 100
Paper II General Awareness 25 75
Paper II English Language 25 75
Paper III Concerned Trade Subject 50 150
Total 150 400

The total examination duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Paper I has no negative marking, while Papers II and III carry a penalty of one mark for each incorrect answer. The question paper will be in English and Hindi, except for the English Language section.

The minimum qualifying marks for the Trade Test and Paper I will be determined and notified by the institute. Papers II and III will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in Paper I.

How to Apply for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply through the official CSIR-CFTRI recruitment portal until 18 November 2026. Submission of the online form alone is not sufficient. Candidates must also send the signed hard copy with the prescribed documents so that it reaches the institute by 26 November 2026.

  1. Visit the official recruitment portal at recruitment.cftri.res.in.
  2. Open the link for Recruitment for the post of Technician (1), Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026.
  3. Complete registration and enter the required personal and contact details.
  4. Select the appropriate trade and post code.
  5. Fill in the educational qualification, experience and category information.
  6. Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents.
  7. Pay the application fee through SBI Collect, if applicable, and upload the payment receipt.
  8. Submit the online form and download the completed application.
  9. Sign the printed form and attach the required self-attested documents and photograph.
  10. Send the hard copy through Speed Post or Registered Post to the specified address by 26 November 2026.

CSIR CFTRI Technician Hard Copy Submission Address

Recruitment Section (E-I Section),
CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute,
Cheluvamba Mansion (Opposite to Rail Museum),
Mysuru - 570020,
Karnataka.

The envelope must mention APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF, the relevant Post Code and Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026. Candidates applying for multiple post codes must send separate completed applications with the applicable supporting documents.

Applications that do not meet the online submission and hard copy requirements within the prescribed deadlines will be rejected.

RRB NTPC Live Photo Requirements

  • The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera.
  • Use a pure plain white background.
  • Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast.
  • Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression.
  • The entire face must be clearly visible and centered.
  • The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area.
  • Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph.
  • Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph.

Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026.

The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist.

  1. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts.
  2. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents.
  4. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post.

Is There a Typing Test in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?

No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

UCO Bank invites online applications from candidates for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended). Candidates can apply for only one State/UT. Selection is through an online objective test conducted by the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India (BFSI SSC), followed by a local language test during document verification and a medical fitness check. Apprentices are trainees, not employees of the Bank, and have no right to employment after training.

There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen/Disabled Ex-servicemen, and they are not engaged as apprentices.

UCO Bank Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

UCO Bank Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The graduation mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2022.

UCO Bank Apprentice Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Nationality: A citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries and Vietnam with the intention of settling in India (the last three categories need an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).
  • Candidates must not have undergone, or be currently undergoing, apprenticeship with UCO Bank or any other organisation, and apprentices terminated by their organisation are not eligible.
  • Candidates with training or job experience of one year or more after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
  • Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding at least one local language of that State/UT. A language test is conducted during document verification; candidates who produce a 10th or 12th mark sheet showing they studied the local language are exempt.
  • Candidates may apply for only one State/UT; multiple applications will be rejected (only the last valid application is considered).

The merit list is prepared State-wise and category-wise in descending order of marks; ties are broken in favour of the older candidate.

How the Online Test Is Taken

  • Eligible applicants who have paid the fee receive an exam link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the exam.
  • The test is taken from the candidate's own residence, using their own camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone, in isolation from other people (except PwBD candidates).
  • Candidates must display the Aadhaar card they uploaded on the NATS portal as ID proof for image capture.
  • Failure to register for the written test results in disqualification. Responses may be analysed for similarity patterns, and results of candidates whose scores are found not genuine can be withheld.

Local Language Test, Medical Fitness and Wait List

The local language test is held during document verification. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. The Bank may declare a wait list at its discretion to cover non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates.

How to Apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

UCO Bank Apprentice Apply Online

Applications are accepted online only; no hard copy of the application or documents is to be sent to the Bank. The process is:

  1. Register on NATS: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal (nats.education.gov.in, "Student Register/Login") and note your Enrolment ID.
  2. Apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship: After logging in, view the "UCO Bank" apprenticeship advertisement and apply for it on the portal, choosing one State/UT.
  3. Check your email from BFSI SSC: Candidates who applied on NATS receive an email from BFSI SSC ([email protected]) inviting them to provide caste category, choice of districts for training, and other details, and to pay the fee.
  4. Complete details and pay the fee: Submit the additional information and pay the online fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026. Details entered must match those on the NATS portal.
  5. Upload documents: Upload the photograph, signature, date of birth proof, graduation certificates and other certificates as required by the apprenticeship portal or when advised by the Bank or BFSI SSC.
  6. Appear for the online test: Take the test on 7 November 2026 using the link sent by email.

The candidate's name must be spelt exactly as in the certificates/mark sheets, percentage should be given to two decimals (CGPA must be converted to percentage), and no change is allowed after submission.

UCO Bank Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the engagement process is complete; call letters and intimations are sent by email/SMS only.
  • Original certificates for educational qualification, age and category must be produced at document verification, or candidature is cancelled.
  • OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026; EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26); PwBD candidates need a disability certificate (UDID/certificates may be verified, and a medical board may reassess).
  • Apprentices are trainees, not employees; PF, ESI, bonus and other labour-law provisions do not apply, they may not join or form a union, and the Bank has no obligation to offer employment after training.
  • Candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship before training begins; those who absent themselves may have to refund training costs and stipend received.
  • Travel costs for document verification are borne by the candidate. Requests for changes of contact details, address, email or test centre are not entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. All disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Courts at Kolkata.
  • All revisions and corrigenda will be published only on www.uco.bank.in (career section).

Sports Qualification – HC/GD
