Selection is purely on merit, against the vacancies notified in each discipline. When two or more sportspersons score the same marks in a discipline, the younger candidate gets preference. The names of successful candidates will be published separately. Their candidature stays provisional until their qualifications and certificates are verified and found genuine, and other formalities are complete.

How to Apply Online for RRC SER Recruitment 2026

Applications are accepted only online, between 31 October 2026 and 30 November 2026 (23.59 Hrs). Applications sent directly to RRC will not be entertained.

  1. Visit the RRC-SER website, www.rrcser.co.in, and click the "Online/E-Application for Sports Quota(OA) / 2026-27" link, then "New Registration".
  2. Fill in your personal details: Name, Father's name, Date of Birth, Community, E-mail address and Mobile number. These must match your Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Note the registration number and password sent to you by E-mail/SMS.
  3. Log in with the registration number and password, and complete the registration step by step.
  4. Enter your bank account details for the fee refund, or confirm that the refund should go to the account used for payment.
  5. Enter the details of a valid photo identity card and upload it.
  6. Upload the scanned photograph, signature and LTI, and the self-attested certificates for date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/EWS), income, OBC and minority self-declarations, and sports achievements.
  7. Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking.
  8. Submit the application. Note the Unique Registration Number generated at submission, which is needed at later stages.
  9. Take two (02) printouts of the completed application form. No change is allowed after final submission, and the hard copy must be the same as the one submitted online.

Use your own mobile number and a valid, active e-mail ID, and keep them active until recruitment ends. RRC sends all communication only by SMS and E-mail and will not accept requests to change them. For help with the online application, use the Help Line Number and E-mail ID shown on the RRC/SER website.

Photograph, Signature and LTI Specifications

  • Photograph: colour, passport size, white/light background, 3.5 cm X 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application. JPG/JPEG, scanned at 100 DPI, up to 70 KB.
  • The photo must show a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses. If you wear glasses, there must be no glare and the eyes must be clearly visible. It must match your appearance at the trial, document verification and medical test.
  • The same photo must be used at every stage. The notice advises keeping at least 06 (Six) copies.
  • Signature and LTI: in black ink on white paper, within a box of 50 mm x 20 mm or 140X60 pixels. JPG/JPEG at 100 dpi, file size 10-40 KB. Both must be the applicant's own.
  • The signature must be in Hindi or English, not in capital or disjointed letters, and the same at every stage. A different signing style at the trial, document verification or medical examination may lead to cancellation.

Documents Required (PDF format only)

  • A self-attested copy of a valid photo identity card issued by a government body (Aadhar card/PAN card/Driving License/Voter ID Card). Carry this card with the e-call letter at every stage.
  • A self-attested certificate in proof of educational qualification issued by the Board/Council/University (para 3.5).
  • Sports achievement certificates only for Championships concluded on or after 01.04.2024, from recognised Sports Association of Indian University.
  • A self-attested certificate in proof of age (Matriculation/10th certificate).
  • Self-attested certificates in proof of all recognised sports achievements as per paras 3.2, 3.3 and 3.4.
  • SC/ST: a self-attested community certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-I).
  • OBC-NCL: a self-attested community certificate (Annexure-II) and a self-declaration that the candidate is not in the Creamy Layer (Annexure-IIA).
  • EBC: a self-attested Income Certificate from the Competent Authority in the Annexure-III format.
  • EWS: a self-attested EWS certificate from the Competent Authority (Annexure-IV).
  • Minority: a declaration for the waiver of examination fees (Annexure-V).
  • Ex-Servicemen: the discharge certificate and pension documents (copy of PPO).
  • Certificates in languages other than English or Hindi must come with an attested English/Hindi translation.
  • Serving employees: a No-Objection Certificate from the employer.

What to Bring to the Trial

Bring the original documents for date of birth, educational qualification, sports achievements and identification. Without them, you will not be allowed to appear in the selection. Also bring the e-call letter, the original photo identity card used in the online application, and 02 self-attested copies of every document uploaded with the application. You must bring your own kit. No TA/DA or accommodation is given for the trial. You may need to stay 2-3 days and must make your own arrangements. SC/ST candidates are eligible for free second-class rail travel to attend the sports trials.

Invalid Applications

The notice says applications with any of these defects will be summarily rejected (the list is illustrative, not exhaustive):

  • Applications sent manually and not registered online.
  • More than one application registered by the same candidate.
  • Applications received after the closing date.
  • No fee paid, or less than the prescribed fee paid.
  • Incomplete, faulty or ineligible applications.
  • An undated or unsigned application, or a signature in block, capital or disjointed letters.
  • No proper scanned photograph, signature and LTI or other enclosures. This includes a black-and-white, capped, sunglassed, disfigured, small, full-body, side-view or unrecognisable photo.
  • No photo identity card or proper certificates of date of birth, education, sports achievement and caste uploaded. Certificates not from the appropriate authority are liable to rejection.
  • The candidate lacks the prescribed qualification and minimum sports achievements when applying.
  • Over age, or date of birth not filled in or wrongly filled in.
  • A compulsory enclosure is missing, or a column is left blank.
  • The discipline is not mentioned in the application.
  • Any other irregularity that RRC/SER considers invalid.

RRC SER Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Selected candidates are likely to be posted anywhere on South Eastern Railway after all pre-appointment formalities, including training where prescribed.
  • Selected candidates must submit a Service Bond to serve 5 years with the railway.
  • Candidates appointed to Clerk-cum-typist posts in Group-C must gain typing proficiency of 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within four years of appointment. Until then, the appointment is provisional.
  • Candidates debarred from any RRB/RRC exam need not apply unless their debarment ends by the closing date of this notification.
  • A candidate found ineligible at any stage may be rejected, and one appointed in error is liable to be summarily removed from service.
  • Name, spellings and dates must match the Matriculation certificate. If there is a significant mismatch, the candidature will be cancelled from the day the discrepancy is noticed.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The Railway Administration may fix any date, change the place, or postpone or cancel the trials for unforeseen reasons. No claim will be accepted.
  • Lists of eligible and ineligible candidates, trial dates and venues, and the e-call letter/admit card link will be published on the RRC/SER website. Ineligible candidates will be informed only through the list on the website.
  • South Eastern Railway has not appointed any agent or coaching centre. Report anyone offering selection to the Chairman, Railway Recruitment Cell, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043, or to the Sr. Dy. General Manager, South Eastern Railway, Garden Reach, Kolkata-700043.
  • The decision of South Eastern Railway in all matters is final. For any legal dispute, the jurisdiction is the Central Administrative Tribunal, Calcutta.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification and two years of relevant experience in their selected trade by 9 November 2026.

Post-Wise Educational Qualification and Experience

Trade Educational Qualification Experience
Fitter ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Fitter trade 2 years in the Fitter trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Electrician ITI / NAC in Electrician trade and a valid statutory licence 2 years in the Electrician trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Instrumentation ITI / NAC in Instrumentation trade 2 years in the Instrumentation trade or discipline in a reputed industrial establishment, including eligible on-the-job or apprenticeship training
Attendant Operator Chemical Plant (AOCP) ITI / NAC in Attendant Operator (Chemical Plant) OR 10+2 Science (Intermediate/Higher Secondary) with Chemistry as one of the subjects and at least 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the operation of chemical and allied process industries, including eligible apprenticeship training

Important: The AOCP post provides an alternative 10+2 Science eligibility route with Chemistry and a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. Candidates applying through this route must still satisfy the two-year relevant experience requirement.

IREL Internal Candidates

Existing employees on IREL's regular rolls are eligible under the special educational qualification route of SSC with four years of experience in the relevant trade or operation, subject to the notification's other conditions.

Experience Requirements

  • Two years of relevant post-qualification experience is required for external applicants.
  • Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, will be counted toward relevant experience.
  • On-the-job training may be included where it meets the relevant trade conditions.
  • Teaching or Research Fellowship experience is not accepted as relevant post-qualification work experience.
  • Prescribed qualifications must be obtained through full-time regular courses recognized by the applicable competent authorities.
  • Applicants must provide valid experience documentation when required for verification.

The advertisement also requires good communication and behavioural skills and knowledge of working in an automated environment, including proficiency in office automation tools.

Selected candidates will undergo one year of training and receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 34,200 per month.

Benefits During Training

  • Consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 34,200.
  • House Rent Allowance at the applicable posting-location rate, calculated on the minimum basic pay of Rs. 22,000, if company bachelor accommodation is not provided.
  • Medical facilities for the trainee and eligible dependent family members as applicable to W-3 grade employees.

Pay and Benefits After Training

On successful completion of training, trainees may be absorbed as regular Tradesmen in W-3 Grade, carrying the pay scale of Rs. 22,000–88,000.

Eligible regular employees may receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, increments, medical facilities, leave encashment, incentives, uniforms, provident fund, gratuity and other benefits according to company rules.

Salary Clarification: The approximate annual CTC of Rs. 6.5 lakh applies after absorption into regular employment and is calculated using an assumed 20% HRA for a Y-class city. It is not the training-period salary or guaranteed in-hand pay.

IREL Tradesman Trainee Selection Process 2026

The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill Test or Trade Test and document verification.

  1. Computer Based Written Examination.
  2. Shortlisting for the Skill Test in the ratio of 1:5 based on CBT merit.
  3. Qualifying Skill Test / Trade Test or Computer Proficiency Test, as applicable.
  4. Preparation of unit-wise, trade-wise and category-wise merit lists using CBT marks.
  5. Document Verification.
  6. Pre-employment Medical Examination and other prescribed verification.

Final Merit Rule: Only candidates qualifying in the Skill Test will be considered for final selection. Final merit will be determined using CBT marks only. Skill Test marks will not be added to the final merit.

Vacancies are available at IREL units in Odisha, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.

The initial posting location will be based on the unit selected by the candidate during the online application. Requests to change the selected initial posting location will not be entertained.

Transfer Condition: After appointment, employees are liable to be transferred to any IREL unit, office or project site in India. Applicants must be willing to serve anywhere in the country.

  1. Visit the official IREL website at www.irel.co.in.
  2. Open the recruitment announcement for Tradesman Trainee - Advertisement No. CO/HRM/36/2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and application instructions.
  4. Select the relevant recruitment registration link.

  11. Check all entered information using the Preview option.
  12. Complete final submission and pay the applicable application and processing fees online.
  13. Save the payment acknowledgement and download or print the submitted application form.

Application Warning: Candidates can edit their application details only before final submission. Once submitted, the form cannot be edited. Applicants must not apply for more than one trade or unit.

AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Remuneration & Allowances

As per DoPT OM F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, a fixed monthly remuneration is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. This fixed amount remains unchanged for the entire term of the contract – there is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period.

Allowances (per DoPT OM dated 09.12.2020)

  • HRA: Not admissible.
  • Transport Allowance: A fixed amount for commuting between residence and place of work, not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement; this amount also remains unchanged during the appointment. TA/DA on official tour, if any, is admissible as per the consultant’s entitlement at the time of retirement.
  • TDS will be deducted at source from the remuneration.

AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Selection Process

  • There is no written examination. Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and are shortlisted will be called for Application Verification followed by an Interview.
  • Final selection is based on merit ranking of the interview alone.
  • The schedule for verification/interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only on their registered email ID.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the application verification/interview, for joining the assignment, on its completion, or at any point during the engagement process.
  • Mere submission of an application, or meeting the eligibility criteria, does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection.
  • Prior to commencement of the contract, AAI may require the selected consultant to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate (equivalent to defence medical standards) from a recognized physician, duly certified by the ATS In-Charge of the Joint User Defence Airfield where deployment is likely.

How to Apply for AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026

  1. Download and fill the Application Form in the prescribed format (Annexure-1 to the Advertisement).
  2. Attach self-attested copies of all necessary supporting documents, proof of Educational Qualification and Work Experience.
  3. Combine the duly filled application and all supporting documents into a single PDF file not exceeding 5 MB.
  4. Email the combined PDF to [email protected] on or before 11 November 2026.
Important: Applications through any mode other than the specified email will NOT be accepted. Ensure the email ID given in the application remains active, as all call letters and further information will be sent by email only.

Documents Required

  • Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-1), including: name, date of birth, age as on 01.10.2026, father’s name, gender, service branch (Army/Navy/Air Force/Coast Guard), date of joining and date of discharge from the Armed Forces, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email ID
  • Details of Educational/Professional Qualification – exam/qualification, university/college, month & year of passing, percentage of marks
  • Details of Work Experience – organization/department, designation with level, period (from-to), total experience, nature of work (attach a separate sheet if required)
  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents substantiating educational qualification and work experience claims
  • A recent photograph, and the candidate’s signature with the declaration on the application form

Important Conditions

Period of Engagement

  • Initial engagement is for 1 year only, extendable by 1 more year at a time; the total cumulative period cannot exceed 5 years, and no extension can take the consultant beyond 55 years of age.
  • The engagement is full-time; consultants will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the engagement period.
  • A formal Contract/Agreement specifying the terms and conditions will be drawn up between the selected consultant and AAI.

Charter of Duties

Consultants will assist and support Air Traffic Control (ATC) operations at the concerned Joint User Defence Airfield, including ATC/SMC operations, watch extension, and other ATC-related activities as assigned by the ATS In-Charge.

Leave Provisions

  • Leave is allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service.
  • Consultants must mark attendance daily at their place of reporting/engagement.
  • Unavailed leave in a calendar year is neither carried forward nor encashed into the next year.
  • Absence beyond admissible leave and notified holidays results in a proportionate deduction from the consultancy remuneration.
  • AAI may terminate the engagement if the consultant remains absent without intimation to the supervisory authority for more than 3 working days.

Other Conditions

  • In case of death, injury or illness of the consultant attributable to the performance of services under the contract, AAI shall not be responsible for any compensation.
  • False or insufficient information, or lack of proof to ascertain eligibility, will lead to summary rejection of candidature at any stage, with appropriate action as deemed fit.
  • AAI reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received, and to cancel/modify/withdraw/postpone this engagement notice.
  • AAI may terminate a consultant’s services at any time by giving 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu of the notice period, and AAI management’s decision is final. A consultant may similarly seek termination by giving AAI 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu.

DC MSME Recruitment 2026 is for 7 Chief Executive Officer (CEO) posts in the autonomous bodies of the Office of Development Commissioner (MSME), New Delhi, Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India. The posts are General Manager, Principal Director and Director at Kolkata, Kannauj, Firozabad, Bhubaneswar, Jalandhar, Ludhiana and Agra. Pay is at Level-12 to Level-13A (as per 7th CPC), with an Entry Pay (Basic) of Rs. 78,800/- to Rs. 1,31,100/- plus DA, TA and HRA (in case accommodation is not provided). Most posts ask for 15 years' experience. The posts are on contract for 5 years initially, with further extension. Citizens of India can apply by speed post or registered post, and the application must reach New Delhi by 23 November 2026.

DC MSME Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

Particulars Details

The official notification does not specify the application fee or the stages of the selection process.

About DC MSME

The Office of Development Commissioner (MSME), New Delhi, works under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India. This recruitment fills the CEO posts of its autonomous bodies: the Central Tool Room & Training Centres (CTTC) at Kolkata and Bhubaneswar, the Fragrance & Flavour Development Centre (FFDC) at Kannauj, the Centre for Development of Glass Industry (CDGI) at Firozabad, the Central Institute of Hand Tools (CIHT) at Jalandhar, the Central Tool Room (CTR) at Ludhiana and the Central Footwear Training Institute (CFTI) at Agra.

No. Post Autonomous Body and Location Vacancies

Who Can Apply

Only citizens of India can apply. Only post-qualification experience in the relevant field counts towards the experience required for each post. Each post's qualification and experience are listed below as the notice prints them, in the notice's order.

General Manager, CTTC, Kolkata

  • Essential qualification: Degree in Mechanical /Production Engg or equivalent from a recognized University / Institution.
  • Desirable qualification: Post Graduate qualification in Engineering/ Technology/ Management from recognized University/Institution.
  • Essential experience: 15 years experience in Production/Training Department of a Tool Room/reputed Engineering Industry of which 10 years in a responsible technology/ Management Position.
  • Desirable experience: Implementation & Management of Engineering Projects, experience in use of computerized MIS including reverse engineering, Rapid Prototyping, CAD/ CAM and CNC Technologies etc. and experience in Administration, Finance & Labour Management.

Principal Director, FFDC, Kannauj

  • Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Chemistry/ Botany/ Agronomy or degree in Chemical Technology/ Chemical Engg./ Agriculture Engg. from a recognized University/ Institution.
  • Desirable qualification: Doctoral degree in Chemistry/ Botany/ Agronomy or Post- Graduate degree in Chemical Technology/ Chemical Engg./ Agricultural Engg. Or Post Graduate Diploma or degree in Management/ Computer Science.
  • Essential experience: 15 years experience in a responsible position in an Industrial Establishment/ technical/ R&D organization dealing with fine chemicals/ phyto-chemicals or aromatic and medicinal plants cultivation/ processing or creation of fragrance/ flavours, or quality management in phytochemicals and fine chemicals.
  • Desirable experience: Experience in production/ R&D work/ teaching/ conducting training programmes in organizations dealing with aroma chemicals, essentials oils, flavors & fragrances, aromatic & medicinal plants, spices and oleo resins. Experience in Human Resource and Financial Management, Industrial Relations and General Administration.
  • Experience relaxation: In case of exceptionally deserving suitable & meritorious candidates, requirements of experience can be relaxed at the discretion of Chairman, Governing Council.

Principal Director, CDGI, Firozabad

  • Essential qualification: Degree in Ceramic/ Silicate/ Glass Technology or equivalent with glass as a main subject from a recognized university or institute with 15 years experience in production/ research in a glass/ ceramic industry/ R&D organization in a responsible position.
  • Desirable qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Ceramic/ Silicate/ Glass Technology or management with experience in implementation of glass projects and manufacture of different types of glasses/ glass products.
  • Experience: Experience in financial, personnel management and general administration.

General Manager, CTTC, Bhubaneswar

  • Essential qualification: Degree in Mechanical /Production Engg from a recognized University / Institution.
  • Desirable qualification: Post Graduate qualification in Engineering/ Technology/ Management from recognized Institution.
  • Essential experience: 15 years experience in Production/Training Department of a Tool Room/reputed Engineering Industry of which 10 years in a responsible technology/ Management Position.
  • Preferable: Implementation of Engineering Projects preferably with foreign collaboration, experience in use of computerized MIS including reverse engineering, Rapid Prototyping etc. Experience in administration, Finance & Labour management CAD/ CAM and CNC Technologies.

Principal Director, CIHT, Jalandhar

  • Essential qualification: Degree in Mechanical /Production Engg or equivalent from a recognized University / Institution.
  • Desirable qualification: Post Graduate qualification in Engineering/ Technology/ Management from recognized Institution.
  • Essential experience: 15 years experience in Production/Training Department of a Tool Room/reputed Engineering Industry of which 10 years in a Managerial technical Position.
  • Preferable: Implementation and management of Engineering Projects experience in use of computerized MIS including reverse engineering, Rapid Prototyping, CAD/ CAM and CNC Technologies. Experience in Administration, Finance and Labour management.

General Manager, CTR, Ludhiana

  • Essential qualification: Degree in Mechanical /Production Engg or equivalent from a recognized University / Institution.
  • Desirable qualification: Post Graduate qualification in Engineering/ Technology/ Management from recognized University/ Institution.
  • Essential experience: 15 years experience in Production/Training Department of a Tool Room/reputed Engineering Industry of which 10 years in a responsible technology/ Management Position.
  • Desirable experience: Implementation and management of Engineering Projects experience in use of computerized MIS including reverse engineering, Rapid Prototyping, CAD/ CAM and CNC Technologies. Experience in Administration, Finance and Labour management.

Director, CFTI, Agra

  • Essential qualification and experience: Degree in Leather Technology/ Chemical Engineering or Polymer Technology from a recognized University or equivalent and 7 Years experience in responsible capacity in footwear training institution or technical organization dealing with footwear or footwear manufacturing unit.
  • OR Diploma in Leather Technology/Diploma in Footwear Technology from a recognized Institution and 12 years experience in responsible capacity in footwear training institution or technical organization dealing with footwear or footwear manufacturing unit.
  • Desirable: (i) Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from recognized institution. (ii) Experience in teaching/ conducting training progammes.

Post Scale of Pay Entry Pay (Basic)

General Manager, CTR, Ludhiana Level-13A (as per 7th CPC) Rs. 1,31,100/-
Director, CFTI, Agra Level-12 (as per 7th CPC) Rs. 78,800/-

The notice prints the same benefit for every post: "This post besides basic pay carries allowances as per Government Rules", with the entry pay above "and other associated emoluments such as DA, TA, HRA (in case accommodation is not provided), as per norms."

The posts are to be filled on contract basis for a period of 5 years initially, with further extension based on the review of performance till the age of superannuation.

DC MSME Recruitment 2026 Job Description

The notice gives one set of duties for all 7 CEO posts:

  • Be responsible for the day-to-day management and affairs of the autonomous body, enhancing the competitiveness of MSMEs in the sector, with a focus on improving their access to technology, providing skill up-gradation and offering advocacy support.
  • Provide leadership in business growth, building client relationships and manpower development.
  • Oversee and provide guidance for Marketing, Production, Training, Design, Consultancy, R&D etc. as required.
  • Work towards building the competencies of the Centre in new and upcoming areas of technology.
  • Co-ordinate and exercise general supervision over all activities of the Centre.
  • Be responsible for revenue generation of the centre for self sustenance.

How to Apply for DC MSME Recruitment 2026

Applications are offline only, by speed post or registered post. The notice gives these steps:

  1. Get the application Proforma from the detailed advertisement on any of these websites: www.dcmsme.gov.in, www.ffdcindia.org, www.cftiagra.org.in, www.cdgiindia.net, www.cttc.gov.in, www.ciht.in, www.msmetoolroomkolkata.com or www.ctrludhiana.org.
  2. Fill in the application in the Proforma and attach the supporting documents.
  3. Prepare a separate application for each post and location you apply for.
  4. Write on the envelope "application for the vacancy of" followed by the position and location you are applying for.
  5. Send it by speed post or registered post to: Additional Development Commissioner (TR), Office of the Development Commissioner (MSME), Room No. 32082, 2nd Floor, Kartavya Bhawan-3, Janpath Road, New Delhi-110001.
  6. Make sure the application reaches by 23 November 2026, the last date of receipt of application.

Candidates working in Central/State Govt. or any Govt. Undertaking/Autonomous organizations must send their application through proper channel. They may send an advance copy to O/o DC (MSME) and produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview.

Documents named in the notice

  • Duly filled application in the Proforma given in the detailed advertisement
  • Supporting documents
  • NOC, for candidates in government service, at the time of interview

About TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd., a leading old Private Sector Bank on a high growth path, invites applications from dynamic and result-oriented retired banking professionals. Selected candidates will function as Mobile Inspectors of Branches, undertaking rigorous internal audits, vault checks, KYC and AML compliance verifications, and operational risk assessments across branch networks.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil all specified criteria to be eligible for selection.

Age Limit

The age of the candidate must not be more than 62 years.

Eligibility Conditions

  • The retired officers of TMB or other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement.
  • The officers should have been in Scale II, Scale III or Scale IV cadre during retirement. Previous work experience in the inspection or audit department will be given preference.
  • Only suitable persons with a good track record to suit the bank's requirement will be engaged on a contract basis.
  • Officers with unblemished service alone are eligible to apply.
  • Officers who were removed or dismissed from the bank's service under disciplinary measures are not eligible.

Pay and Tenure

The contract will be initially given for a period of 1 year and, based on a satisfactory performance report, it will be renewed for a further period of 1 year, making the total contract period 2 years.

Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹35,000/- per month. No other allowance or perquisites including bonus, ex-gratia, variable pay, LFC, and medical reimbursement as admissible to regular employees will be paid or given. However, they are eligible to avail all other allowances provided to the Mobile Inspector of Branches such as lodging expenses and halting allowance, which will be paid as applicable to their respective cadre.

TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches Job Description

Selected officers will handle responsibilities associated with the Inspection Division, including:

  • Verify that all branch activities are conducted as per the bank's internal policies, procedures, and circulars.
  • Ensure adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulations and other statutory requirements.
  • Check compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) norms.
  • Scrutinize cash transactions, deposits, advances, and other high-value entries for irregularities.
  • Verify cash balance and vault holdings against records.
  • Examine loan and advance portfolios for proper documentation, sanctioning procedures, and follow-up.
  • Ensure interest calculations and charges are correctly applied.
  • Identify potential operational, credit, Trade Finance, and compliance risks at the branch level.
  • Check for fraud-prone areas such as dormant accounts, unauthorized overdrafts, or forged documents.
  • Evaluate the adequacy of internal controls and inspect security items like gold, title deeds, and pledged or mortgaged properties.
  • Verify security systems such as CCTV, alarm systems, and fire safety measures, and check insurance coverage of branch assets.
  • Assess branch service standards, review customer complaints and resolution processes, and observe staff-customer interactions.
  • Audit account opening forms, loan files, vouchers, registers, safe custody, locker registers, and complaint registers, and ensure proper record retention and disposal.
  • Verify staff attendance, leave records, code of conduct adherence, job role definition, and review training needs.
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports highlighting observations, irregularities, risks identified, and recommendations for corrective action.
  • Submit findings to the Regional Office or Head Office Inspection Division, follow up on compliance with previous inspection recommendations, and perform other related duties.

How to Apply for TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches

  1. Go to the TMB website career portal at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ and click on "Apply Online" under the recruitment advertisement for Mobile Inspector of Branches.
  2. Register with a correct email ID and mobile number to create a User ID, noting the unique Registration Number and Password sent via SMS.
  3. Click the activation link sent to the registered email ID to access the Careers portal.
  4. Log in using the Application number and password, fill in all details carefully across pages, and click "Save/ Continue". Ensure all names match certificates and mark sheets exactly.
  5. Upload a scanned photograph (390 x 520 pixels preferred, max size 120 KB) and a scanned signature in non-capital letters (240 x 240 pixels preferred, max size 60 KB).
  6. Upload required enclosures (max size 250 KB each), including a self-attested photocopy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet / Transfer Certificate for age proof, degree certificates, experience certificates, relieving letters, and the last month's salary slip.
  7. Submit the online application form by clicking confirm/submit at the bottom of the page to receive the "Registration is successful" message, then save and print the system-generated application form.

Selection and Interview

Shortlisted candidates must appear for an interview. They will be called for a personal interview conducted through Direct or Video Conferencing. The mode of interview, date, and time will be communicated to eligible candidates individually by post or email.

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. is on a high growth path and invites applications from dynamic and result-oriented individuals for leadership roles in its financial operations. The selected candidate will manage statutory accounts, financial control systems, tax matters including GST, and provide critical financial insights to top management from the Bank's Head Office in Thoothukudi.

Who Can Apply

  • Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant by Qualification
  • Experience: Ten years of experience in overseeing financial operations, preferably accounting and taxation matters, in Banks/ Large corporates / PSUs/ FIs/ Financial services organizations.
  • Age Limit: Minimum – 45 years and not more than 55 years as on 30.09.2026 (Age is not a constraint for a right candidate).
  • Other Eligibility: No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI/Statutory Authority, shall be pending against the candidate identified for appointment as Vice President.

Pay and Terms

Remuneration is as applicable to Vice President. The appointment is made on a regular basis with a posting at the Head Office, Thoothukudi. The job role and location is subject to transferable based on requirements.

TMB Deputy Chief Financial Officer Job Description

  • Managing the financial affairs, including management and statutory accounts together with longer term financial projections and to ensure that the most efficient and effective financial control systems and reporting mechanisms are in place.
  • Preparing the year-end financial accounts for audit and to liaise with the Auditors prior to finalisation.
  • Liaise with Inland Revenue, Customs and Excise, Income Tax Department and the Auditors.
  • Takeover all GST matters and keeping abreast of current GST legislation.
  • Managing all external contracts and to ensure that all the banks expenditure is correctly authorised and accounted for.
  • To ensure the overall smooth running of the banks internal administration and its cost-effectiveness.
  • To ensure the banks legal responsibilities are met, in particular that all necessary insurance is properly in place.
  • Direct accounting processes, overseeing the compliance of applicable legal regulations. perform all kind of banking and financial operations.
  • To follow the Long Form Audit report submitted by statuary auditors.
  • Implementation of Ind As.
  • Developing financial strategies at an organisational level by leading financial and accounting information, analysis, and recommendations to strategic thinking and direction of the Bank.
  • Participating in the corporate decision-making process as a member of the management team with joint responsibility for the development of long-term corporate strategies and company policies.
  • Management and Information Analysis: will be an advisor to the top management for providing financial insights on competitive benchmarking, performance analytics, forecasting and budgeting, headcount and compensation forecasting, balance sheet management / ROE, unit costing, client profitability, regional profitability and product profitability, and leveraging corporate resources to standardize reporting and automate processes.
  • Have a deep understanding of capital and liquidity management, assisting on all funding decisions and helping to manage the balance sheet, capital dividend policy, and allocation of capital.
  • Monitoring and review finance related policies, procedures and practices in line with international accounting standards, legal requirements and industry best practices.
  • Along with the senior leadership team will be responsible for driving transformation and delivering shareholder value.

Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Mumbai Office, has announced the RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 for preparing a panel of 22 Pharmacists on a contract basis. Candidates with D.Pharm or B.Pharm, Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council registration, and at least two years of pharmacist experience can apply. The remuneration is Rs. 600 per hour, and applications must reach RBI by 3 November 2026, 5 PM.

The engagement is purely contractual for a maximum period of 240 days at a stretch, depending on the Bank's requirements. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form with supporting documents and also complete the additional details through the link mentioned in the official advertisement.

RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 Quick Summary

Job Location Mumbai and Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
Employment Type Contractual, need-based engagement
Official Website rbi.org.in

Important: RBI is preparing a panel of 22 Pharmacists. Selection for the panel does not guarantee daily engagement, continuous employment for 240 days, or permanent appointment in the Bank.

RBI Pharmacist Vacancy Details 2026

RBI has announced 22 panel vacancies for Pharmacists at its Mumbai Office. The category-wise distribution is given below.

Category Vacancies
General / Unreserved 13
OBC 5

Candidates claiming reservation must submit valid category certificates in the prescribed format. OBC candidates claiming reservation must submit a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued after 1 April 2026. The EWS Income and Asset Certificate must relate to financial year 2025-26 and be valid for 2026-27.

RBI Pharmacist Eligibility Criteria 2026

Applicants must satisfy the educational qualification, professional registration, experience and computer knowledge requirements specified by RBI.

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination.
  • Candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized university, as specified in the notification, or a Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm).
  • Registration with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council is compulsory.
  • Candidates must have basic working knowledge of computers.

Experience Requirement

Applicants must have at least two years of experience working as a Pharmacist. Candidates with experience in Public Sector Banks (PSBs), Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), or Government organizations will be given preference.

Can Freshers Apply for RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026?

No. Candidates without the required two years of pharmacist experience do not meet the eligibility criteria. Possessing D.Pharm or B.Pharm alone is not sufficient.

Is Maharashtra Pharmacy Council Registration Mandatory?

Yes. RBI specifically requires applicants to be registered with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council. Registration with another state pharmacy council alone is not stated as sufficient in the notification.

RBI Pharmacist Age Limit 2026

The notification does not specify a numerical minimum or maximum age limit. However, applicants must provide their date of birth and calculate their age as on 1 October 2026 in the prescribed application form.

RBI Pharmacist Salary 2026 - Per Hour, Per Day and Per Month

RBI Pharmacists will receive fixed remuneration of Rs. 600 per hour for a maximum of five hours per day. The maximum daily remuneration is Rs. 3,000. There is no guaranteed fixed monthly salary because engagement depends on the Bank's requirements.

Salary Component Amount
Hourly Remuneration Rs. 600
Maximum Duty Hours Per Day 5 hours
Maximum Daily Remuneration Rs. 3,000
Additional Allowances Not payable
Fixed Monthly Salary Not guaranteed

RBI Pharmacist Monthly Salary Calculation

The following table illustrates possible monthly remuneration based on working five hours per day. These amounts are calculations, not guaranteed monthly payments.

Working Days Hours Per Day Illustrative Earnings

Example: If a Pharmacist works for five hours per day for 20 days, the remuneration would be 20 × 5 × Rs. 600 = Rs. 60,000, before any applicable deductions.

The Bank does not guarantee five hours of work every day or a fixed number of working days per month.

RBI Pharmacist Selection Process 2026

RBI will shortlist eligible applicants for an interview. Shortlisting will consider educational qualifications, relevant experience and distance of residence from the Bank's dispensaries.

The recruitment process includes:

  1. Shortlisting based on educational qualifications, residence distance and experience.
  2. Interview for shortlisted candidates.
  3. Medical examination for candidates shortlisted after the interview.
  4. Document verification before engagement.
  5. Empanelment and engagement according to the Bank's requirements.

RBI may raise its shortlisting standards to limit the number of applicants called for interview. Merely meeting the minimum eligibility conditions does not guarantee an interview call.

The notification does not specify a written examination. No travelling allowance or other interview-related allowance will be paid.

Is RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 a Permanent Job?

No. The Pharmacist engagement is purely contractual and does not constitute regular RBI employment.

  • The maximum engagement period is 240 days at a stretch.
  • Pharmacists may be engaged only when required.
  • Selection for the panel does not guarantee daily employment.
  • The engagement does not provide a right to permanent or temporary appointment in RBI.
  • Facilities available to regular RBI employees are not applicable.
  • RBI may discontinue utilization of the services at any time without notice or assigning a reason.

Candidates should consider these conditions before applying, particularly if they are looking for a permanent banking job with regular monthly pay.

RBI Pharmacist Job Location and Duty Hours

Selected candidates may be assigned to one or more RBI dispensaries situated in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai. RBI will decide the dispensary allocation based on its requirements.

Duty hours will depend on the assigned dispensary, subject to a maximum of five hours per day under the advertised remuneration terms. Candidates must be prepared to work at the locations allocated by the Bank.

RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The prescribed application form is provided in Annex-I of the official recruitment notification, covering pages 5 to 7.

The application form requests the following information:

  • Full name and gender
  • Residential address, mobile number and email ID
  • Date of birth and age as on 1 October 2026
  • Place of birth and domicile
  • Category and nationality
  • Educational qualifications, year of passing and percentage
  • Additional courses completed, if any
  • Post-qualification experience as a Pharmacist
  • Other relevant information
  • Applicant's signature, place and date

Documents Required for RBI Pharmacist Application 2026

Applicants should enclose the required self-attested copies of certificates and documents with the prescribed application form.

  • Recent self-attested passport-size photograph
  • Age-proof certificate
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • D.Pharm or B.Pharm qualification documents
  • Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council registration certificate
  • Relevant pharmacist experience certificates
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate, where applicable
  • Other relevant supporting certificates

Candidates already working as Pharmacists in another institution must also mention their current employment details and working hours in the application.

How to Apply for RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026

Candidates must submit the prescribed application physically and furnish additional details through the link specified in the RBI advertisement.

  1. Read the complete RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 notification.
  2. Download or print the prescribed application form available in Annex-I.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational, registration and experience details.
  4. Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph.
  5. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates.
  6. Sign the declaration and complete the place and date fields.
  7. Place the completed application and supporting documents in a sealed envelope.
  8. Write the prescribed application description on the envelope.
  9. Send the sealed application to the RBI Mumbai Regional Office address given below.
  10. Also complete the required information through the additional link specified in the official advertisement.

Shahid Bhagat Singh Road,
Fort, Mumbai - 400001.

What Should Be Written on the Application Envelope?

The envelope should be superscribed as follows:

Application for the post of Pharmacist on contract basis with fixed hourly remuneration, Mumbai

Last Date: The completed application must reach RBI on or before 3 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB) has notified the recruitment for Credit Trainer posts on a contract basis for a period of 6 months under its 2026 recruitment. The position carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 50,000 per month, with no other allowances or perquisites. Eligible applicants must be retired officers of banks or other banks in Scale III or above cadre with a good track record and unblemished service. Candidates can apply online by registering with a valid email ID and mobile number and uploading the required documents from 17 October 2026 to 31 October 2026. The selection process consists of an interview conducted directly or through video conferencing.

Who Can Apply

Candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions as specified in the official notification:

  • Retirement Status: The retired officers of our banks/other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement.
  • Cadre Requirement: The officers should have been in Scale III or above cadre during retirement. Previous work experience in the Credit Department will be given preference.
  • Track Record: Only suitable persons with a good track record to suit the bank's requirement will be engaged on a contract basis. Officers with unblemished service alone are eligible to apply.
  • Disqualification: Officers who were removed /dismissed from the bank's service under disciplinary measures are not eligible.
  • Age Limit: Not more than 62 years.

Pay and Tenure

Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹50,000/- per month for a contract period of 6 months. No other allowance or perquisites including bonus/ex-gratia/variable pay, LFC and medical reimbursement as admissible to the regular employees of the bank will be paid/given.

TMB Credit Trainer Job Description

The roles and responsibilities assigned to Credit Trainers include:

  • Deliver training programs on banking products, credit policies, and loan processes.
  • Train employees on retail, MSME, housing, and personal loan underwriting procedures.
  • Explain credit appraisal techniques, financial analysis, and risk assessment methods.
  • Conduct sessions on documentation, compliance, KYC, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Develop training materials, presentations, case studies, and assessment modules.
  • Support new joiners during induction and onboarding programs.
  • Monitor trainee performance through tests, assignments, and practical evaluations.
  • Provide coaching on customer handling, sales quality, and portfolio management.
  • Ensure employees understand bank policies related to NPA control and recovery practices.
  • Coordinate with business teams and credit departments for process updates.
  • Identify training needs and recommend skill development initiatives.
  • Maintain training records, attendance, certifications, and MIS reports.
  • Conduct refresher training programs whenever policy or product changes occur.
  • Assist branches and field teams in improving credit quality and operational efficiency.
  • Support audit readiness and adherence to internal credit standards.
  • Any other work assigned by the Bank.

  1. Candidates are requested to log on to the Bank’s website (https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/). Click “Apply Online” and register themselves for the appropriate post.

  3. Note down the Unique Registration Number and Password sent to your mobile number and email for applying online.
  4. Click the activation link sent to the registered E-mail ID which will direct to the Careers portal.
  5. Login with the Application number (Registration Number/Username) and password on the right side of the career portal.
  6. Fill in all details in the online application at appropriate places very carefully, ensuring names match certificates exactly, and click “Save/ Continue”.
  7. Upload photograph with the dimension of 390 X 520 pixels (preferred) and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 120 KB.
  8. Upload signature with the dimension of 240 X 240 pixels (preferred) and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 60 KB (Signature in Capital letters shall NOT be accepted).
  9. Upload the following enclosures to be uploaded along with the e-application and ensure the size of the scanned image is not more than 250 KB: Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof, Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate/s, Experience certificate/s and Relieving Letter for pervious employments, and Last Month Salary Slip.
  10. On successful submission of the Online Application form, click confirm/submit on bottom of the page and a message “Registration is successful” will be displayed. A copy of the system generated online application form will be sent to the registered Email ID and the Candidates should take a printout of the same for future reference.

The shortlisted candidates should appear for interview. They will be called for personal interview through Direct / Video Conferencing. The mode of interview, date and time will be communicated to the eligible candidates individually.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Business, Quality Assurance, Data Operation, and IT Infrastructure.
  • Oversee business collaboration via permanent control towers for AI/data products and ensure seamless integration into formal business processes.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory norms and align with Bank governance standards and top management directives.
  • Oversee independent model validation team and evaluate ongoing risk and performance in models.

DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Bank's risk and operational analytics function and establish an enterprise-wide roadmap across Risk, Compliance, Business, and Operations.
  • Lead design, development, validation, implementation, and operations of AI/ML models for early-warning systems, collections, fraud prevention, operational risk, financial risk, and process optimization.
  • Integrate analytical models and decision engines into core banking, loan origination, and operational workflows via enterprise data and API platforms.
  • Establish human-in-the-loop controls, override mechanisms, audit trails, and escalation procedures for material decisions.
  • Prioritise high-impact use cases based on loss reduction, regulatory importance, customer impact, efficiency, and feasibility.
  • Drive responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI for risk intelligence, document analysis, and operational decision support.

DGM (AI Governance and Compliance)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Bank's AI governance and compliance function across ML, generative AI, and agentic AI.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce AI governance policies, standards, risk-classification methodologies, and control frameworks.
  • Oversee independent validation, periodic review, and governance controls for material models and AI-enabled systems.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable RBI directions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, and information security norms.
  • Coordinate AI risk assessments, privacy impact assessments, security reviews, and approval processes before production deployment.
  • Oversee third-party AI governance, vendor due diligence, contractual safeguards, and data-use restrictions.
  • Convene or support governance committees and coordinate regulatory inspections and audit closures.

DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops)

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead data engineering, model application development, and AI Ops functions to deliver scalable, secure data and AI pipelines.
  • Design, develop, and operate enterprise data pipelines, model-serving platforms, and APIs in coordination with GITC.
  • Establish engineering standards for MLOps, LLMOps, DevSecOps, testing, CI/CD, and release management.
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, rollback, recalibration, and retirement for AI/ML models and agentic AI applications.
  • Implement observability covering availability, latency, throughput, data quality, performance, capacity, and compute utilisation.
  • Manage technology vendors, systems integrators, and platform providers.

AI Solution Architect

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business units and technology teams to identify, conceptualize, design, and implement scalable AI solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into AI solution concepts, functional blueprints, and user journeys.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, enterprise architects, and application teams to develop implementable technical designs.
  • Define AI risk controls, guardrails, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and explainability requirements.
  • Support development of business cases, evaluate alternative approaches, and guide PoCs and pilots.
  • Create reusable solution patterns, templates, and blueprints for common AI use cases across the Bank.

Enterprise AI Architect

Job Profile and Key Responsibilities:

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Bank's enterprise AI architecture strategy and on-premises NVIDIA-based AI platform.
  • Design and optimize GPU infrastructure and workload architectures leveraging NVIDIA AI Enterprise ecosystem.
  • Lead architectural design of Generative AI, LLM solutions, RAG, and vector databases.
  • Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, model gateways, model serving mechanisms, and API integration strategies.
  • Architect secure and scalable enterprise data platforms and enforce technology standards, security, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and manage architecture exceptions.

How to Apply for SBI Recruitment 2026

Candidates must submit their applications online through the official careers portal of State Bank of India. No hard copy of the application or documents needs to be sent by post.

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal and navigate to the current openings page.
  2. Locate the link for Specialist Cadre Officers recruitment under advertisement CRPD/SCO/2026-27/30.
  3. Register online by entering basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password. The facility for editing saved application details is available up to three times only before final submission.
  4. Fill in the online application form carefully with educational, professional, and personal details.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, biodata, resume, ID proof, age proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, salary slips/Form-16, and other required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 750/- (exempted for SC/ST/PwBD) online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
  7. Submit the completed application form and print a copy of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Document Upload Specifications:

  • Photograph: Recent passport style colour picture (20 kb to 50 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 200 x 230 pixels, light-coloured or white background).
  • Signature: Signed on white paper with Black Ink pen (10 kb to 20 kb, JPG/JPEG format, preferred dimensions 140 x 60 pixels; signatures in capital letters are not accepted).
  • Other Documents: Biodata, Resume, ID proof, Proof of Date of Birth, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate (if applicable), Form-16/Offer Letter/Latest Salary Slip, and CTC negotiation sheet must be uploaded in PDF format on A4 size, with file size not exceeding 500 kb each.

Queries: For any queries, candidates can write via the "CONTACT US/ Post Your Query" link available on the Bank's website (https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/post-your-query) or email [email protected].

Selection and Interview

The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation.

  • Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates.
  • Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent.
  • CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process.
  • Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order.

Travelling Allowance for Interview: Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting will be reimbursed the cost of travelling by Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route in India as follows:

  • GM & Chief AI officer and all three DGM posts (Sl. No. 1 to 4): Reimbursement of actual Air Fare (Economy Class).
  • AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect (Sl. No. 5 & 6): Reimbursement of Air Fare up to Rs. 15,000/- (Total for both sides) or actual fare, whichever is lower.
  • Note: In case a candidate called for interview is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification, Experience, etc.), he/she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled to reimbursement of any travelling expenses.

Punjab & Sind Bank, Human Resource Development Deptt has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) on a contract basis. The engagement is for a fixed contractual tenure of minimum three years, extendable at Bank's discretion, and is purely contractual without conferring any right to claim regular employment. Candidates holding a Graduate or equivalent degree from a reputed Govt. recognized University and must be CAIIB are eligible to apply. The compensation and terms & conditions are negotiable depending upon the suitability of the candidate. Eligible applicants can submit the ONLINE application from 15 October 2026 to 30 October 2026 through the Bank's website. The selection process involves preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting, and personal interaction or interview before the Selection Committee.

Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Punjab & Sind Bank
Department or Unit Human Resource Development Department (H.O. HRD Dept.)
Post Chief Compliance Officer (CCO)
Vacancies 1
Pay Negotiable depending upon the suitability of the candidate
Contract Term Minimum 3 years (extendable at Bank's discretion)
Experience Required 15 years in banking or financial services (minimum 5 years in Audit / Finance / Compliance / Legal / Risk Management)
Job Location Head Office/Corporate Office (transferable to any office in India)
How to Apply Online through the Bank's website
Last Date 30.10.2026
Selection Preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting, and personal interaction/interview

Who Can Apply

Candidates must meet the following nationality, qualification, and age criteria to be eligible for the Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) position:

  • Nationality: Must be a Citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan Refugee who came over to India before 1st Jan 1962, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate issued by the Govt. of India.
  • Mandatory Educational Qualifications: Must be a Graduate or have an equivalent degree from a reputed Govt. recognized University and must be CAIIB.
  • Mandatory Experience: 15 years in the banking or financial services, out of which a minimum of five years shall be in the Audit / Finance / Compliance / Legal / Risk Management functions. (Risk management functions include control functions within business lines; regional/zonal/business heads with requisite responsibility in control functions for five years or more are also eligible).
  • Desirable Qualifications: Additional qualifications such as Ph.D. / MBA / LLM / CA / CMA / CS / CFA or Diploma / Degree in Compliance and Ethics or its equivalent. Preference will be given to candidates with these additional qualifications.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 40 years of age and less than 55 years of age as on 01.10.2026, including all relaxations.

Pay and Terms

The compensation and terms & conditions will be negotiated and finalized depending upon the suitability of the candidate. The Chief Compliance Officer is engaged for a fixed contractual tenure of minimum three years, which can be extended at the Bank's discretion subject to satisfactory performance. The engagement is purely contractual and does not attract provisions of PF, Gratuity, or Pension, and no allowances, payments, benefits, or facilities other than those mentioned in the terms are payable. Working hours, weekly offs, and holidays are applicable as per serving employees of the bank. The selected officer is entitled to 30 days of paid leave per calendar year (not more than 5 days at a time); absences exceeding 30 days in a contract year lead to proportionate deductions from the consolidated payment.

Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) Job Description

The Chief Compliance Officer assists senior management in effectively managing compliance risks faced by the bank. The core responsibilities include:

  • Designing and maintaining a compliance framework, conducting compliance training on regulatory and conduct risks, and communicating compliance expectations.
  • Apprising the Board and senior management on regulations, rules, standards, and developments, and providing clarification on compliance issues.
  • Conducting compliance risk assessments at least once a year, developing a risk-oriented activity plan for ACB approval, and reporting promptly on major changes, failures, or breaches.
  • Monitoring and periodically testing compliance, examining sustenance of compliance, and ensuring time-bound compliance with supervisory observations made by the RBI.
  • Framing and implementing a comprehensive Compliance Policy and Compliance Manual for the Bank, and vetting guidelines and circulars before dissemination.
  • Interacting frequently with Legal, Operational Risk Management, Taxation, and Audit/Inspection departments, and submitting quarterly/annual reviews to the Board.
  • Serving as the nodal point of contact between the bank and the RBI, participating in quarterly informal discussions, and ensuring compliance with overseas branch regulations and FEMA requirements.
  • Acting as a member of the 'new product' committees to ensure new products and processes have clearance from all perspectives including compliance.

How to Apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Compliance Officer (CCO)

  1. Log on to the Bank's website at https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and navigate to the "Recruitment" link on the Home Page.
  2. Ensure you have scanned copies of your photograph, signature, thumb impression, hand-written declaration, education certificates, experience certificates, and DOB proof in the specified formats (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .gif for images; PDF for documents).
  3. Fill out the online application form with correct details matching your certificates and identity proof.
  4. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1000/- plus applicable GST (Total fee Rs. 1180/- including CGST and SGST for New Delhi, or IGST for out of New Delhi) via the ONLINE mode only.
  5. Submit the completed online application form before the last date of 30.10.2026 and retain a copy for future reference and interview verification.

Selection Process

The selection process for the Chief Compliance Officer post comprises:

  • Preliminary Scrutiny: Checking applications with reference to age, qualifications, experience, and other eligibility conditions.
  • Shortlisting: Shortlisting candidates based on relevant experience, seniority, professional credentials, academic track record, and suitability.
  • Personal Interaction / Interview: An interview before a duly constituted Selection Committee assessing knowledge of credit, market, operational, liquidity, technology, cyber, climate risks, leadership ability, independence of judgement, and regulatory awareness.
  • Verification: Verification of credentials, vigilance status, integrity, reputation, and antecedents, followed by medical fitness and background checks. Final selection is based on marks obtained in the interview process according to merit ranking.

Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online through the official website between 15.10.2026 and 30.10.2026. No other mode of application is accepted.
  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online. Cash, demand drafts, cheques, and money orders are not accepted.
  • Candidates must produce original educational certificates, mark sheets, and experience certificates at the time of document verification and interview.
  • Serving candidates in Government or Public Sector Undertakings including banks must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate.
  • The selected candidate will be posted preferably at the Head Office/Corporate Office, though the bank reserves the right to post them anywhere in India.

National Insurance Company Limited (NICL), a Government of India Undertaking, has released the NICL AO Recruitment 2026 notification for 321 Administrative Officer (Generalist & Specialist) Scale-I posts. NICL AO Negative Marking

There is a penalty for wrong answers in the objective tests of both Phase-I and Phase-II. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty is applied to unanswered questions.

NICL AO Interview and Final Selection

Candidates shortlisted after the Phase-II Main Examination will be called for Interview. Final selection will be based on the marks secured in the Main Examination Objective Test and Interview in the ratio of 80:20.

How to Apply for NICL AO Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for NICL AO Recruitment 2026 from 08 October to 28 October 2026. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted.

  1. Open the official NICL recruitment section.
  2. Open the NICL AO Recruitment 2026 online application link.
  3. Select Click here for New Registration.
  4. Enter your name, contact details and email address.
  5. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated by the system.
  6. Complete the required personal, educational, category and other details.
  7. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the prescribed format.
  8. Preview and verify the complete application carefully.
  9. Click Complete Registration only after verifying all details.
  10. Pay the applicable application fee online.
  11. Submit the application.
  12. Save and print the application form and e-Receipt for future reference.

  • The photograph should be a recent passport-style colour photograph.
  • A light-coloured, preferably white background should be used.
  • The preferred dimensions are 200 × 230 pixels.
  • The file size should be between 20 KB and 50 KB.
  • The candidate's face should be clearly visible.
  • Caps, hats and dark glasses are not permitted. Religious headwear is permitted if it does not cover the face.

In addition to the uploaded photograph, candidates will also be required to capture and upload a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone during the online application process.

NICL AO Signature Requirements

  • Sign on white paper using a black ink pen.
  • Preferred dimensions: 140 × 60 pixels.
  • File size: 10 KB to 20 KB.
  • The signature must be the candidate's own signature.
  • Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.

NICL AO Handwritten Declaration 2026

The handwritten declaration must be written by the candidate in English using black ink and should not be written in capital letters.

  • Apply online between 08 October and 28 October 2026.

  • Keep a printout of the submitted online application and fee e-Receipt.
  • Separate call letters will be issued for Phase-I and Phase-II examinations.
  • Candidates selected for appointment may be posted or transferred anywhere in India according to company requirements.

NICL AO Probation Period

Selected Administrative Officers will initially be on probation for one year. The probation period may be extended as per company rules. During probation, officers are required to pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India for confirmation of service.

NICL AO Service Bond

Selected candidates are required to give an undertaking to serve NICL for a minimum period of four years, including the probation period. Candidates leaving before completion of the bond period will be subject to the conditions and liquidated damages specified in the detailed advertisement.

How to Download the RRB ALP City Intimation Slip

Follow these steps on the official exam portal or your regional RRB website.

  1. Open rrb.digialm.com or the website of your regional RRB.
  2. Find the link for the CEN 01/2026 (RRB ALP) exam city intimation slip.
  3. Click Login and enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  4. Enter the captcha and click Submit.
  5. Your exam city, exam date and shift will appear on the screen. Check every detail.
  6. Download the slip and keep a copy for reference.

If you see a message that the slip is not live, it usually means your exam date has a later release date. Check the date-wise schedule above and try again on your release date.

Details You Will See on the City Intimation Slip

Once you download the slip, check the following details carefully.

  • Candidate name and registration number
  • Allotted exam city and state
  • Exam date and shift
  • Reporting time, gate closing time and exam start time
  • General instructions for the exam day

The slip names only the city. The exact exam centre address is given on the admit card.

RRB ALP City Slip vs Admit Card

Point City intimation slip Admit card (e-call letter)
Purpose Tells you the exam city, date and shift in advance so you can plan travel Allows entry to the exam hall
Centre address Not given Given in full
Valid for exam entry No Yes, with a valid photo ID
Status Released Not Yet Announced

RRB ALP CBT 1 Shift Timings

CBT 1 is held in three shifts a day, and each shift lasts 60 minutes. The timings below are indicative. Your exact shift and reporting time are printed on your slip and admit card, so follow those.

Shift Reporting time Gate closes Exam starts Exam ends
Shift 1 7:30 AM 8:30 AM 9:00 AM 10:00 AM
Shift 2 11:30 AM 12:30 PM 1:00 PM 2:00 PM
Shift 3 3:30 PM 4:30 PM 5:00 PM 6:00 PM

Candidates are not allowed to enter after the gate closes, so plan to reach the centre well before the reporting time.

RRB ALP CBT 1 Exam Pattern

CBT 1 is a screening test. It has 75 questions for 75 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes. The questions come from Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Science and General Awareness. Marking scheme details beyond this are Not Available Officially in the information checked for this article. Candidates should refer to the official CEN 01/2026 notification for the full scheme.

RRB ALP Selection Process

The selection of Assistant Loco Pilots under CEN 01/2026 has these stages.

  1. Computer Based Test 1 (CBT 1)
  2. Computer Based Test 2 (CBT 2)
  3. Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)
  4. Document Verification
  5. Medical Examination

The process is currently at the first stage, CBT 1. Dates for the later stages are Not Yet Announced.

RRB ALP Admit Card 2026: When Will It Be Released?

The official admit card date is Not Yet Announced. RRBs usually release the admit card (e-call letter) about four days before the exam date mentioned on the city slip. The admit card will carry the exact centre address, reporting time, your photo and signature, and exam day instructions. Download it from the same login using your Registration Number and Date of Birth once the link is active.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Download the city slip only from the official portal or your regional RRB website.
  • Check your name, registration number, exam date and city. If anything looks wrong, contact your RRB through its official grievance channel.
  • Do not treat the city slip as an entry pass. Carry your admit card and a valid photo ID to the exam centre.
  • Plan your travel and stay as soon as you know your city, but wait for the admit card for the exact centre address.
  • Reach the centre before the gate closing time. Late entry is not allowed.
  • Whether a change of exam city is allowed is Not Available Officially in the details checked for this article.
